sanskrit: duḥkhitāḥ kānaneṣvadridarīṣvantarguhāsu caūṣurdīrghatamaḥ kālaṃ kvaciddaityairvilakṣitāḥevaṃ varṣasahasrāṇāmatītaṃ dvisahasrakampraṇamya taṃ prāha śakraḥ baddhā'ñjalipuṭastadācirāya paridṛṣṭo'si śiṣye mayi dayāṃ kurupurā vidhiḥ prārthito'pi mayā bhūyaḥ svayaṃ jagaupratīkṣa kālaṃ kālena vinā no sidhyatīhitamna taṃ kālaṃ prapaśyāmi leśato'pi sukhāvahameṣa kuñjaḥ kaṇṭakitaḥ svargo nandanameva cavandinaḥ karaṭā ete śālūrāḥ stutivācanāḥupadhānaṃ gulmapādo mantrā'hvānaṃ śivādhvaniḥcāmarāḥ kaṇṭakitaruśākhā vātyāpravepitāḥnūnaṃ bhāgyaṃ mamaivaitadityuktvā mūrcchito'bhavatsamāśvāsyā'marapatiḥ provācā'ṅgiraso vacaḥāpatsu harṣakalitāḥ sampatsu samatāṃ gatāḥśokaṃ jitvā vimarśena sandhairyeṇa mahājanāḥśṛṇu te'trā'bhidhāsyāmi vyavasāyaṃ phalāvahamna yonijairmānasairvā mṛtyustasya śiveritaḥdevādyaiḥ puruṣaiścā'pi nā'sya mṛtyurudīritaḥprayāhi śaraṇaṃ nā'sti rakṣako'nyaḥ kathañcanadhyātamātro jagatprāṇaḥ praṇamya samupasthitaḥtvaṃ sarvadāgatiḥ sarvaprāṇaścā'pi mahābalaḥśīghramanyān surān sarvān pāvakapramukhānapitatra pauruṣayogena sādhyaṃ sarvasamīhitamsametā himavacchṛṅge śakrādyāḥ sarvato'marāḥ

sanskrit: kṛtvā darśanadṛśyavibhedān vidhidhān sarvān paribhāsayasibandhkaṃ citparimṛṣyā'ntaryatnādbhūyo bhāsi yathāvatdṛṣṭvā kalpitametatsvīyaṃ nandasyaniśaṃ devi ! namastesa ca lokānāṃ tvamiva maheśvari ! līlādraṣṭā nandati devaḥteṣāmetatparamaṃ rūpaṃ prakaṭitamakṣṇoḥ phalasaṃjananamsṛṇiśaracāpān pāśaṃ bibhradvayamiha bhūyaḥ praṇamāmastatatha tān prāha paramā vatsā uttiṣṭhata drutamkiṃ vo'bhilaṣitaṃ bhūyaḥ pratīcchadhvaṃ guṇeśvarāḥniśamyaivaṃ vaco devyāḥ procurbrahmādayastata.bhagavatīlalitā'virbhāvavarṇanaṃ nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥprāhurbrahmamukhā devīṃ bhaktinamrasumūrtayaḥvidheyamamarā'rīṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ pravihiṃsanamnūnaṃ trilocanenā'sau sarvato'maratāṃ gataḥśrutvaivaṃ dhātṛmukhyānāṃ vacaḥ sā prāha śaṅkarīmā'haṃ yonisamudbhūtā manasā vā'pi kasyacitaprasiddhena cā'streṇa nihanmyenaṃ mahāsuramathovācā'maraguruḥ parāśaktiṃ kṛtāñjaliḥpaśyantu śakrapramukhā bhūyāsustena pāvitāḥśṛṇu jīvaśakramukhā naivaṃ śaktimayīṃ tanumna hi sādhāraṇaḥ kaścidevaṃrūpāṃ prapaśyatiato vo darśitaṃ caitannānyairdṛṣṭaṃ kadācanaatha bhūyo'pi bahudhā prārthayāmāsa tāṃ guruḥyadi māmīdṛśīṃ śakraḥ paśyettacchṛṇu vacmi tedarśayiṣyāmi tasmai svamidaṃ rūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥantardhānaṃ yayau tatra brahmādīnāṃ prapaśyatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrutvā śrītripurādevyā āvirbhāvaṃ tato vṛṣālakṣmīsūktavidhānena bhaktiśradhā'tinirbharaḥevaṃ tasyā'rādhayato māsāḥ ṣaṭ pañca cā'tyayuḥbhaṇḍāsurāya tadvṛttaṃ jñāpayāmāsa sarvaśaḥsāmprataṃ paramāṃ śaktimupatiṣṭhati bhaktitaḥdhvaṃsayiṣyati dāvāgnistṛṇadārucayaṃ yathānā'tropāsyo dṛśyate'nyaḥ sāmno balavadāśriteindrāya pātālamātrarājyastāṃ jagadīśvarīmityuktvā pūjitastena jagāmā'bhimatāṃ gatimmantrayāmāsa daityo'sau sevitaḥ śūnyake purekaścit sāma bhedamanyaḥ parodānamuvācahatadantare viśukrasya putraḥ śukrasamo mataḥśṛṇu rājannarthaśāstramaryādāsahitaṃ vacaḥdṛṣṭyā buddhyākhyayā sattvarūpayā vimṛśet kṛtimsuvimṛśyakaro yastu taṃ sampat pravṛṇotyalamrājā'himatavaktā ca satataṃ svārthatatparaḥyathā naurāsanacchidrā sapānthaṃ nāvikaṃ jaleśṛṇvahaṃ te'bhidhāsyāmi kartavyā'nantarakriyāmaprāptamabhayaṃ strībhyo matvā'lpamiti te mudhārājyaṃ tribhuvane prāpya striyā vinihato balīhatau yuddhe caṇḍikayā sabalāviti naḥ śrutamanyacca te'bhidhāsyāmi cirametaddhi saṃsthitamtaṃ tamuddharate viṣṇurmārgasthamiva kaṇṭakamtoṣitā paramāśaktirāvirbhūtā vadhāya teamānasā yonijebhyo nā'maratvaṃ tvayā vṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa yadāha na cā'lpaṃ tadvidhi daityagaṇeśvara !manīṣiṇā sarvayatnairnirasyaṃ kālajaṃ bhayamsarvathā mūlanāśo hi śaktyā'pohyaḥ prajānatāatra me'bhimataṃ rājan śṛṇu buddhyā vicāritamtapasā pūrvavaddevān śeṣaṃ bhayamapohya caiti te'bhihito mantro nā'taḥ kṣemaṃ bhavet kvacitśrutavarmavacaḥ śrutvā bhaṇḍo daityapatirvacaḥmartukāmasyā'gadavanna tattasya hyarocatadaityeśvara mayā proktaṃ śṛṇvatrā'tisukhāvahameṣa bālastava bhujabalaṃ no vetti kiñcanarājñāṃ yuddhaprasaṅgeṣu kā viprasya bhavenmatiḥnimantraṇavidhānajñāsteṣāṃ yuddheṣu kā gatiḥna khaḍgadhārāṃ jānanti na śūrāḥ śarasaṃstṛtaugrāmasiṃhabibhīṣitaistadebhā mūtramutsṛjuḥtarhi mattebhakumbhasya vipāṭo jambukaiḥ kṛtaḥyoṣidvā puruṣo vāpi nopekṣyaḥ śatrutāṃ gataḥvijeṣyati pratāpā'rkasantāpitajagattrayamkuśāgrairapi viddhaḥ syāllohaśailo nirantaraḥmāmā'jñāpaya te bhṛtyaṃ gatvā'haṃ tānnimeṣataḥśrutvaivaṃ daityavacanaṃ prahṛṣṭo bhaṇḍadānavaḥvatsa ! kiṃ yuddhavārtābhireva bhīto'si vai mudhāyaḥ striyo yuddhavārtābhireva bhīto napuṃsakaḥdhiṅmāṃ yastvādṛśaṃ cakre mantriṇaṃ mantranāśakamityuktvā protthitaḥ khaḍgahasto devān vihiṃsitumyatra śakramukhā devāstripurāṃ samupasthitāḥ

sanskrit: atyantabhītā deveśīmuccaḥ pāhīti saṃjaguḥgaccha jvālāmālini tvaṃ rakṣa bhītān surān drutamjvālayā tān rurodhoccairjvālāmālinikā śivāhatān devān praharṣeṇa bhaṇḍadaityaḥ punaryayauvitrastā martukāmāste chittvā'ṅgāni samantataḥaśeṣā'ṅgāni hutvaivaṃ pūrṇāhutitayā tanumtadantare sā tripurā bhaktarakṣāparāyaṇājātaścaṭacaṭāśabdaḥ kuṇḍamadhyānmahonnataḥjvālāmadhye mahādevīṃ sarvasaundaryasantatimathotthāya śakramukhāstuṣṭuvustāṃ maheśvarīmpuṣpavṛṣṭirabhūdvyomno nedurdundubhayo'pi cabrahmādyāḥ sarvatastasyāḥ pūjāṃ cakruryathāvidhivividhairbhakṣyabhojyādyairāsavaiḥ piśitairapigāyanairnṛtyavādyārdyairutsavairapi bhūriśaḥdvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥvidhātṛmukhyānūcuste devyāḥ saṃsthānahetavepraṇamya prārthayāmāsuryattacchṛṇu ghaṭodbhava !asyāṃ jagatyāṃ yannityaṃ paśyāmastvāṃ maheśvarīmprāpya tvadīyaṃ te lokaṃ paśyāmastvatpadāmbujambrahmāṇḍabhedaṃ nā'rhanti tattvāṃ draṣṭumabhīpsavaḥprārthitetthaṃ brahmamukhaistripurāmbā maheśvarīavasat saparīvārā yathā loke svake tathākāmeśvaraṃ patiṃ cakre samūḍhā'bhavadambikāpapraccha vibhavaśrutyāṃ parāyāṃ jātakautukaḥkīdṛśaṃ kiṃ pramāṇañca yasmin vasati sā parā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñātavānnāma kiṃ tasya saṃsthānañcā'pi kīdṛśamārādhitā sā tripurā prasannā'bhavadambikākiṃ māhātmyaṃ bhavet sūktametanme vaktumarhasiitthaṃ paryanuyuktaḥ sa hayāsyo munisattamaḥśṛṇu kumbhaja vakṣyāmi bhaktiśradhāyuto hyasivaktumarhaṃ sarvathaiva dhanyo'si tvaṃ mahītaleetasya kāraṇaṃ vedmi naitadalpaphalaṃ mune !tripurāpādabhaktistu durlabhā sarvato bhavetśivaviṣṇvādibhaktistu dvāaramatra prakīrtitammucyate sarvathā janturnānyathā kalpakoṭibhiḥloke sāmrājyayuktasya ye'nugāstāratamyataḥanirodhaṃ svoparisthaprāptau mārgaṃ diśanti caprāṅgaṇeśaprāptimāpa diśatyeva ghaṭodbhava !mukhyagauṇaprabhedaśca yathā deheṣu vai śiraḥye ca pādabhavā devāḥ sadā sevanatatparāḥetat saṅgasya māhātmyamaho bhāgyamaho tapaḥyatte priyā satī lopāmudrā'khyā rājakanyakātaddhetuṃ te pravakṣyāmi na tajjānāti kaścanatatsevanaparo rājā sarvadā sarvabhāvataḥpiturdṛṣṭvopāsanāyāḥ kramaṃ devyā yathākramamevaṃ cirā'rādhanena bhaktyā bhāvanayā'pi cavavre cā'sau sarvajagatpūjyāyāḥ pādasevanamlakṣitā cā'pi tāṃ vidyāṃ vāksamudrapariplutāmvidyā ṛṣitvaṃ samprāptā tannāmnā sā sphuṭaṅgatāiti śrutvā kumbhabhavaḥ patnyā vibhavavistaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athā'vadaddhayāsyo'pi prasannaḥ kumbhajanmaneśrīsūktasya vidhānaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ paramapāvanamvidyevaitadgopitavyaṃ sarvatrā'tisugopitampurā śriyā sudṛṣṭaṃ tadvedā'bdheḥ samyaguddhṛtamsamprāptā lokamātṛtvaṃ sarvapūjyatvamāgatāprasannā chandayāmāsa vareṇa tripurā parāvatse ! tvayā vinā viṣṇuraprabhuḥ paripālanetato me niyaterbhaṅga eva nā'rhasi sampratidhārayāmi svarūpañca tatte vakṣyāmi śrūyatāmśrīcakraṃ me bhaveccakraṃ śrīkramaḥ syānmama kramaḥmahālakṣmītyahaṃ khyātā tvattādātmyena saṃsthitāyadyattava priyaṃ loke tanmamā'pi priyaṃ bhavettatrā'hamapi pūjyā syāṃ bhaktairapi viśeṣataḥhutā'pi vividhairdravyaiḥ prasannā vāñchitā'rthadāsarvakāmapradā yantre mūrtyādike'pi vālakṣmīsūktaṃ ṣoḍaśarcaṃ devyāḥ snānavidhau paṭhetpūjā'śaktau kevalaṃ vā sūktante yaḥ paṭhet sadāvidyā'pi tvatsamāyogādbhaviṣyati mama priyāpūrṇā tena samādiṣṭā mahāśrīṣoḍaśākṣarīsā pūjā syānmahāpūjā prasannā'haṃ tato drutampūrṇarūpā prārthitā'haṃ ṛṣibhiḥ pāvakāt pituḥtvamahaṃ devyahaṃ tvañca nāvayorantaraṃ bhavetiti dattvā varaṃ tasyai ramāyai tripurā parāśrīsūktasya mahitvaṃ tenaitadbrūyāḥ kathañcanaatha vakṣye śrīpurasya vṛttaṃ lokottaraṃ śṛṇu

sanskrit: upāsakebhyo dānāni kṛtvā'pi sthānamāpnuyātsa vaseddikpatīnāṃ hi vapre saukhyamavāpnuyāttattattulyanivasatiṃ prāpnuyānnā'tra saṃśayaḥśrīckrājadānantu mahāphalavidhāyakampūjānte tripurāpūjāparaṃ vipraṃ sulakṣaṇamvastrairābharaṇaiḥ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramātsāmānyā'rghodakaṃ haste viprasya samavāsṛjetbhojayedāvṛtimitān brāhmaṇān suvidhānataḥhyathāśaktyā vā'pi viprān bhojayettu prayatnataḥṣoḍaśa brahmaṇāṃścāpi dvādaśā'rādhya bhojayettasya prītā mahādevī svasāyujyaṃ prayacchatisarvaṃ dānaṃ tena dattaṃ tena yajñāstathā kṛtāḥtripurā'pi ca tatkarmasakṛśaṃ nā'sti vai phalamyataḥ sarvajagadrūpapratimaṃ rāma cakrakamyadi kāmanayā kuryādyaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhīpsatievantu sthāvaraṃ yantramagre hārasamanvitamtasya puṇyamananto'pi na śaktaḥ kathane kvacitśāligrāmaṃ kuṇḍalinīmeva dadyāttu bhaktitaḥmandiraṃ cakrarājāderjīrṇaṃ kuryānnavantu yaḥpūjāṃ vā'pi cirocchinnāṃ pravartayati yaḥ punaḥsarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi bhārgava !dhanamānādyapekṣaḥ san kramadīkṣādirītitaḥyathecchaṃ nivasennāthamaṇḍale'nte vimucyatekāmānmohāt pramādādvā vairāgyādvā niṣedhatitayorna vidyate lokaḥ prāpsyato hyadhamāṅgatim

sanskrit: vidyālobhayuto maurkhyāt so'pi yātyadhamāṃ gatimsampradāyaṃ vijijñāsuṃ na niśidhyet kathañcanaanyaddānamanātmākhyamapi bandhakaram bhavetvidyālikhitadānena cā'pi tatphalam syādanantakamvidyālikhitadānena cā'pi tatphalamāpnuyātevaṃ mahāphalaprāptistripuropāsanāvidhaumāhātmyavaibhavo yasya śravaṇādbhaktimān bhaveteṣa māhātmyakhaṇḍo vai tripurāyā rahasyakeparamaṃ sādhanaṃ hyetadātmabandhavimuktayesā māhātmayaśrutimṛte yato na bhavati kvacitmāhatmyaśravaṇaṃ loke mokṣadvāramidaṃ smṛtambhakyā vinā paraṃ śreyaḥ kathaṃ syāddevatā parāyathā taruṇyāḥ saundarya vinasaṃsarvathā tathātathā bhaktiṃ vinā jñānaṃ phalaṃ na janayet kvacittasmādbhaktivihīnasya na kvacit syād dhṛtiḥ kvacittasmādetaṃ saṃśṛṇuyāt khaṇḍaṃ māhātmyasaṃjñitampaṭhitavyaṃ nityametadadhyāyaṃ ślokameva vāetadāyuṣyajananaṃ saumaṅgalyavivardhanamyadyatsamīhitaṃ tattatprāpyate'sya hi saṃśruteḥvicāritaṃ jñānabhaktivairāgyādipradaṃ nṛnāmamṛtāḥ śivamukhyāḥ syuḥ sā mātā tripuraiva hṛīmupāsakamukhyadharmavarṇanaṃ nāmā'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sanskrit: bahirantaḥ kāṃsyatāmramayasthalayutā'ntaraḥgṛheṣu rājate teṣu vasantartuḥ supeśalaḥsaṃyutaḥ svaparīvāraiḥ samedhate nijaśriyāproktarītyaiva vijñeyā viśeṣaḥ procyate kramātgrīṣmartuḥ saṃsthitaḥ śukraśuciśaktiparīvṛtaḥnabhonabhasyaśaktibhyāṃ varṣartustatra śobhateśaradṛturiṣorjā (?) bhyāṃ śaktibhyāṃ tatra rājatesahassahasyaśaktibhyāṃ himantastatra rājatekadambavipinaṃ tatra hālā'modasumeduramkīramaṇḍalacāṭūktimadhuradhvanisundaramsaṅgītamāṭṛkā devī mātaṅgītyabhiviśrutāvīṇāveṇumukhā tadvacchyāmalā laghupūrvikāśrīmātṛkā tatpriyā'nyā (i?) cetyevamaṣṭadiksthitāḥatha vapraḥ puṣparāgamayaḥ pūrvoktavat sthitaḥpadmarāgamayo vaprastadanto'gniśikhā'ruṇaḥsālo gomedamaṇijastatra bhairavanāyakaiḥkarālā kālameghābhā karavālakṛtā'yudhādvātriśatkoṭibaṭukayutaḥ saṃsevitā sadātato vajramayaḥ sālastatra vajrā nadī sthitātaṭābhyāṃ gaomedavajramayābhyāṃ pravibhāsinīvajrapradānasantuṣṭā vajripramukhapūjitānirantara. dhyāyamānāḥ parāmbāpādapaṅkajammuktāvaprastadantasthā dikpālā dikṣu vai kramāttāladrusyandadatyantahālāsaurabhasambhūtaḥaparādhijanān daṇḍeyojayantī susaṃsthitā

sanskrit: tato vidrumasālaḥ syādvaprāttatrā'ntare sthitaḥnavaratnakṛto vaprastato'tiruciraḥ śubhaḥtato'pyanekaratnaughamayo vapro'tibhāsuraḥtato manomayaḥ sālo'ruṇoruṇasamacchaviḥpraphullapadmasaṅkīrṇā tryaṃśemadhyabhuvaḥ sthitātanmadhye navaratnāḍhyanaukāyāṃ suvirājiteasaṃkhyaratnapotasthaśaktibhiḥ parivāritāatha budhimayaḥ sālo viśadaścandravimbavattatra'mṛteśī taraṇisaṃsthānā śaktibhirvṭāājñāṃvinā'mṛteśānyā nainat pibati kaścanaahaṅkāramayastasmādvaraṇaḥ śyāmalā'kṛtiḥmimarśā'khyā jñānarasavahaniścalaśitalātadājñāmantarā tatra naiṣat prāpnotī tadrasamtyajanti tāpaṃ pa"yanti jagattattvamanāvṛtamtatrā'ntare samāsīnaḥ sūryo jalajaviṣṭaretatra somaḥ sthito rājā kiraṃstatra sudhāṃ'śubhiḥkaustubhā'khyamaṇibrātanirmito rucirā'kṛtiḥtatra kaustubhasaṅkḷptapote śṛṅgāranāmakeanekakoṭikandarapiratiprītigaṇairapitatpāre tu mahāpadmavanamāmodameduramkarṇikāścāpi cā'tyantadīrghāstatte bravīmyahamviṃśatiryojanānāntu patrā'yāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥyojanānāṃ pañcadaśa kesarāṇāñca dīrghatātatra bhṛṅgāmaṇinibhāḥ śailaśṛṅgamitāḥ sthitāḥcintāmaṇipravekā'tiracitaṃ citracitritam

sanskrit: vahnimūrtimayā'dhāro vartulastatkalāyutaḥtatra sūryātmakaṃ pātraṃ kalādvādaśasamyutamtatrā'mṛtā'savaḥ pūrṇaḥ svādyo mañjulasaurabhaḥtatra potasthitaḥ khelaṃstaraṅgeṣvāsavā'mṛtemahāpadmā'ṭavīsaṃsthāścā'pi yāḥ śaktyo'malāḥtatrā'gneyaṃ yaṃ mahākuṇḍaṃ cidagnijvālamālitamśatayojanamunnamrā vistṛtā mekhalāḥ pṛthakdvisahasrayojanonnatajvālāmālayā'vṛtaḥnānāmaṇigaṇā'kīrṇaḥ sahasrayojanā'yataḥdaśendriyahayopeto manaḥ sārathisaṃyutaḥnabhao vitānaḥ sumahān sarvalokamayaḥ sthitaḥnavā'varaṇadevībhiryutaḥ paramaśobhanaḥkāmeśvarā'ṅksaṃsthānā jyotīrūpā virājateśrīpuravarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥpapracchā'nantaraṃ vākyaṃ sarvalokapitāmahamhṛdi tat paripṛcchāmi vaktuṃ tanme tvamarhasina gatistatra cā'nyeṣāṃ guṇajebhya iti śrutamkathametat sthitaṃ deva kṛpāṃ kuru mayīśvaratvaṣṭaḥ ! śṛṇu samākhyāsye caitadvṛttaṃ sugopitamsadā samākulasvāntaistoṣitā'smābhirambikāniṣkalā'kāśarupeṇa kevalaṃ vaṅmayī śivāsaṃśrutvaivaṃ vācaṃ natvā'smābhiḥ samīritammahādevi vayañcā'smin jagatkṛtye nirantaramtvatsvarūpasthitiṃ tyaktvā na kiñcidabhirocatetatkṛpāṃ kuru deveśi ! na ramāmo'tra karmasu

sanskrit: vidhimukhyāḥ sāmprataṃ no bhavedetat kathañcanacintituṃ nā'rhathaivaṃ vo dāsye'nyadabhivāñchitamyadyevamamba tattvañca guṇamūrtirmaheśvarīkuru tatra vayaṃ nityaṃ tvanmūrtterabhiṣevaṇātityasmadīritaṃ śrutvā prāha sā tripurā parānā'ṭrā'ṇḍeṣu sthitiṃ prāpsye kintvaśeṣā'ṇḍavartināmtatra māṃ bhaktibhāvena yajantu jagadīśvarāḥyathepsitaṃ dhyāyata māṃ strīpumprakṛtitaḥ śubhāmtatrā'khilā'ṇḍasaṃsthānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ nirantaramityuktvā'smān vihdhimukhānantardhānaṃ jagāma sāpīyūṣā'bdhiṃ samāsādya ratnadvīpaṃ samantataḥnavaratnamayaḥ |svīyacchavivytāptadigantaraḥproktamānaṃ tatra vahniyojanaṃ syātkathantvatiatha devaḥ śivaḥ kuṇḍe svākṣṇo'gnimanukalpayatviṣṇu svayaṃ svacerto'śairedhāṃsi samkalpayatmanaḥpaśuṃ buddhimajyamahaṅkāraṃ havistathāabhidhyāyamahaṃ svā'ntarvahnau strīmūrtimīdṛśīmkuṇḍavahneḥ samudabhūt dhyānarūpā'nusāriṇīniryayau pāvakāttasmādbahistrailokyasundarīādiṣṭa evaṃ paramamāsanaṃ kalpitaṃ mayākalpitaṃ vividhaṃ sāraṃ sparśācchīrṇa babhau kṣaṇātparaḥśataṃ viśīrṇāni tadā'haṃ lajjito'bhavamtadicchayaiva turyaśca tau tāṃ devīṃ praṇematuḥdadhyau sadāśivaḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ tasyāḥ kṣṇādathasadāśivā īśvarāśca tebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ eva ca

sanskrit: sadāśivāṃ'śena tatra sindūranicayā'ruṇamīśarudraharividhiśaktisaṅghacatuṣṭayaiḥaśeṣapṛthivīsārasambhṛtā'staraṇaṃ tataḥāstṛtaṃ meruśikharisamudāyasusādhitampraṇamya prāha tāṃ devīṃ siddhamamba! samāruhaprocurdeva naupayikaṃ pīṭhametaddhi mandiramsadāśivo'pi yuktaṃ tanmatvā cakre gṛhaṃ śubhamyojanānāṃ dve sahasre vistṛtau gṛharājakaḥnabhomayavitānena mahatā'tivirājitaḥsasarja tasya parito mahapadmavanaṃ śubhamevaṃ tanmandire ratnasiṃhāsanamadhīśvarīratnasiṃhāsane tasmin saṃsthitā sā maheśvarīsaṃstutā bahudhā prāha sadāśivamadhīśvarīākhyātā'haṃ yena loke bhavāmi viditā'kṛtiḥyāvattasyāḥ samākhyānaṃ cintayāmāsa mānasedeva naupayikaṃ hyetadbhāsate na parāmbikādhyānā'nurodhavapuṣā dayayā dṛśyatāṃ gatānā'tyartha śobhate lokavigānāditi manmaheṛte sambhavate vallī taruhīnā yathā bhuviparaṃ kalpaya yannaḥ syāt sarveṣāmabhivāṇchitamcintayitvā ciraṃ vākyaṃ prāha vyavasitā'ntaraḥiyaṃ parātparā devī saścinmātrasvarūpīna sannā'sadabhinnaṃ vā vibhinnaṃ kimapi hyabhūtetajagaścakracitraṃ svātmanyādarśalīlayāsadasyāḥ sarvalokaikamāturbhartā'tra ko bhavet

sanskrit: vadatyevaṃ sadā pūrve śiva'smākaṃ prapaśyatāmīṣat smitaṃ kṛtavatī koṭipūrṇendubhāsanamvidalan śrotrajālāni badhirīkṛtadiktaṭaḥtaḍitkoṭyu dayā'bhāsaṃ sarvacakṣuḥ pramoṣaṇambadhirā'ndhīkṛtāḥ kiṃ tadityāścaryaṃ samāgatāḥsamānasundarā'ṅgasya paryaṅkamaṇiśobhinīdṛṣṭvā samānapuruṣavāmā'ṅkasuvirājitāmsvā'ṅgasaundaryalālityabharaṇenaiva parasparamathā'.bravīnnaḥ paramā devā vaḥ siddhamīpsitamvadantvāvayornāmani (?) ryāvaḥ khyātiṃ yatastvihavimūḍhānāha natvā tāṃ devyasmatkāmapūraṇātrājarājātmanāṃ nastvamīśanāścā'pi sāmpratamtvaṃ vai tripurasundarī caiṣa tripurasundaraḥaprārthayanta bhūyastāṃ matvā tatraikalāṃ sthitāmdṛṣṭvaikalāṃ tvāṃ na vayaṃ hṛṣyāmo'titarāṃ śiveprāṃ svasadṛśīṃśaktimasṛjat pratibimbavatiti sṛja śakticakraṃ mamā'nuguṇamuttamamomityuktvā ca sā devī śakticakraṃ mahā'dbhutamtāvanmadhye mahādevī svayaṃ ṣo'śadhā'bhavatetasminnantare sā'pi mahatripurasundarrīpṛthaksṛjethāḥ svasvā'nurūpāḥ śaktīrmanoharāḥevaṃ sṛṣṭparīvārā mahāśrītripurā'mbikātattatsthānasthitābhiḥ sā śaktibhiḥ sevitā'bhavatśakticakrasaṃsthānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥpapracchaḥ bhūyaḥ praṇatastacchru tāvatikautukī

sanskrit: nṛpasaṃkyā nāma tāsāṃ rūpaṃ sthānañca me vadakiṃrūpāḥ kati saṃkhyākāstatsṛṣṭāścā'pi varṇayasṛṣṭaṃ śrītripurāśaktyā kutra kāḥ śaktyaḥ sthitāiti pṛṣṭo viśvakṛtā prītaḥ prāha caturmukhaḥevamādau visṛṣṭā sā mhātripurasundarīsamājñaptāstayā tāstu prāhustripurasundarīmśrutveti prāha sā bhūyo mahātripurasundarīityuktvā'dyā samasṛjaddśaśaktīḥ sulohitāḥpāśā'bjā'ṅkuśapāṇayaḥ śaśikhaṇḍaśikhaṇḍakāḥvaśitvā prākāmyakā ca bhuktīcchāprāptayaḥ kramātatha tā navaśakyastu prāhurdevīṃ svamātaramśrutvā'ha tā mahāśaktīrmahātripurasundarīathā'dyā prārthayāmāsa tripureśīṃ praṇamya tuprārthitaivaṃ parāśaktiḥ sasarja sthānamadbhutamdviśataṃ yojanānāntu vistāreṇa vinirmitābahirvihāya tasyāntaścaturddhāraṃ suśobhanamṣaṭyojanasudīrghañca tatsambaddha tadantataḥdviyojanā tato'ntastu yojanoccā tathā punaḥbhūmikā yojanonnamnā ṣoḍaśacchadasannibhāyojanānāntu viṃśatyā bhūmikā'timanoharābhūmikā śakrakoṇābhā tadantaścā'pi tāvatīyojanoccā pūrvavattu daśakoṇasamaprabhāvasukoṇātmikā bhūmiryojanocchrāyaśobhinīyojanoścā vadūrdhvasthā tāvaducchrāyaśobhinīprakalpya sthānamevaṃ sā vṛttabhūmau svayaṃ sthitā

sanskrit: svāṅgodbhūtāḥ śaktayo yāḥ svasamā nṛpasaṃkhyakāḥindoḥ kalāmayaḥ pakṣadinā'dhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥādyā kāmeśvarī nityā dvitīyā bhagamālinīmahāvidyeśvarī paścācchivadūtī tataḥ paramvijayā sarvamaṅgalā jvālāmālā tataḥ parampañcakakramayogena tryasrabhūmau niveśitāḥsā tapovīryasaṃyogāt sāyujyaṃ samupāgatātāṃ bindubhūmyadhiṣṭhātrīṃ kṛtvā svāgre niveśayattābhiścā'pi pṛthakkṛtyairnām prāptaṃ yathākramamsampradāyā'kulottīrṇā nirbhagā ca rahasyakāniveśitāḥ krameṇaitā devyā cakreṣu tacchṇṇumanudigdiṅnāgavahnikoṇeṣūrdhve pṛthak pṛthakdaśaśaktīradho bhūmyāṃ krameṇa viniveśayatvargaśaktīrdvitīyasyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ niveśayattṛtīyabhūnikāyāṃ tāḥ krameṇā'bhiniveśayatasṛjattāvatīḥ śaktīratha guptatarā'bhidhāsvassaṃsthānasammityā'sṛjacchaktīrvicitritāḥrahasyataranāmnī ca śaktimekāṃ sasarja haśaktīḥ svasvasamākārā'yudhavastravibhūṣaṇāḥviniyuktā mūladevyā śaktīnāmabhidhā'kṛtautṛtīyabhūmikādevyo yāḥ sṛṣṭā daśasaṅkhyakāḥāharanti mudaṃ devyastasmānmudrāsamā'hvyāḥdrāvayatyākaraṣayati vaśayenmādayatyapitrikhaṇḍayati yonyātmabhāvamānayatīśvarīvidrāviṇyākarṣaṇī ca tataḥ paścādvaśaṅkarī

sanskrit: bījā yonih kramādetā dikṣu koṇeṣvadhordhvayoḥkaumārī vaiṣṇavī vaiṣṇavī vārāhī māhendrī tataḥ parambrhmādīnāṃ samānāṅgā'yudhā'bharaṇavāsasaḥlohitā'ṅkuśadhāriṇyaḥ padmarāgasubhūṣaṇāḥkāmākarṣiṇikā'dyā syād buddhyākarṣiṇikā parāsparśā'karṣiṇikā tadvadrūpā'karṣiṇikā tataḥākarṣiṇī dairyapūrvā karṣiṇī smṛtipūrvikāātmā'karṣiṇikā tadvadamṛtā'karṣiṇī tataḥbhāvitā guptayoginyā'grapatrādvāmataḥ sthitāḥpāśadānasudhākumbhā'ṅkuśā'yudhapariṣkṛtāḥmadanā'naṅgamadanā'turā'naṅgā'dyarekhikāetā guptatarā'khyotthā nāgacchadaniveśanāḥpāśaṃ nīlotpalaṃ pātramaṅkuśaṃ pāṇiṣusthitamsammohinī stambhinī ca jṛmbhiṇī ca vaśaṅkarīsampattipūraṇī mantramayī dvandvakṣayaṅkarīagrādvāmakrameṇaiva raktābhāṃ'śukabhūṣaṇāḥsiddhīpradā sampatpradā tataḥ paścātpriyaṅkarīduḥkhādvimocanī tdvanmṛtyupraśamanī tataḥsaubhāgyadāyinī paṅktikoṇe prāgvat samāsthitāḥdadhānā viśadā'kārāṃ'śukabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥjñānaśaktiraiśvaryapradā tatojñānamayī smṛtātataḥ pāpaharā'nandamayī rakṣāsvarūpīpāśadānajñānaṭaṅkakarā raktāṅgabhūṣaṇāḥvaśinī modinī tadvadvimalā cā'ruṇā tataḥrahasyayoginījātāḥ padmarāgasamaprabhāḥ

sanskrit: nāgakoṇeṣu pūrvoktakrameṇa suvirājitāḥevaṃ tāḥ śaktayaścakre sṛṣṭāḥ prakṛtiśaktibhiḥśrīcakradevatānirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥpitāmaha śrutañcaitacchrīcakraṃ śaktimaṇḍalamtathā'ṣṭā're trikoṇe ca kutaḥ sthānaṃ viśaktikamevaṃ tvaṣṭā'nuyukto'tha prītaḥ prāha caturmukhaḥmahāśrītripureśānyā sṛṣṭāstri (ni?) tyāstu ṣoḍaśa(?) nāma tāsāṃ pṛthaksvīyakriyayaiva nirupitamtasyāḥ sadā vilasitaṃ jagadetaścarā'caramjagaścakrakriyākāṇḍaṃ nirvāhayati cinmayīanekadhā'pi bhavati svasvātantryā'vabhāsinīeko'pyenakadhāpyāste yathā vā vārnidhiḥ sthitaḥśaktryo'śātmikāstasyā aṇimādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥyā śaktiryatkriyāheturnāma tasyāstathāsthitamspardhāñcakruḥ saṃsthitiṣu sthānanācoccabhāvataḥmahādvyājñayā prāha mahātripurasundarīspardhākrodhātmanāmatra sthānaṃ devīsamīpataḥityuktvā'dau svayañcakre tapaḥ sumahadadbhutamanyāḥ sarvā api tapaścakrurniyatamānasāḥagāt kālo dīrghatamastadā tuṣṭā'vadat parāityuktvā sthānamadiśanmahātripurasundarīatha nityā'tmaśaktīnāṃ tryasrabhūmau niveśanampradiṣṭasammukhasthānā'pyamanyata na tadbahuevaṃ kāmeśvarī tadvadbhagamālinikā'pi caevaṃ tapasyabhirate śaktimaṇḍalake śivā

sanskrit: tāvadvijñāyā'bhimataṃ mahātripurasundarītā visṛṣṭāḥ sthite sthānaṃ mahātripurasundarīmityuktvā tapa evaoccaiścakruḥ prāk śaktibhiḥ sahaavalokanato jātāḥ śaktyo vedasaṅkhyakāḥdṛṣṭvā śaktigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tapasyabhirataṃ sadābhūyo dadarśa parito jātaṃ śakticatuṣṭayamtriṇetrāśca tapasyeva ratā dṛṣṭvā ca pūrvajāḥdadhānā aṅkuśañcāpi raktavarṇavibhūṣaṇāḥpāśābhayavarasṛṇidharaśca tapa āsthitāḥtapasyeva ratāstāśca dṛṣṭvā śaktīḥ puraḥ sthitāḥnityāṃ ṣoḍaśikāṃ vatse varaṃ brūhyabhivāñchitamprāptā ca parayā tatra sāyujyaṃ ṣoḍaśī parāsvayantu pañcamī bhūtvā tāsāṃ tuṣṭā samāsthitāratneśvarītvamādyānāṃ kāmadhuktvaṃ tataḥ paramlakṣmīśvarītvamantyānāṃ śaktivṛndā'sane sthitimratnāḥ kāmadaghāḥ kalpalatākośā'bhidhāyutāḥpañcaviṃśatisāhasrasaṃkhyāstāstu pṛthakpṛthakpañcasāhasra sasaṃkhyākā mūladevyāstu śaktyaḥtṛtīyā bhuvaneśānī turyā vārāhikā matāsudhāpīṭheśarī cā'dyā sudhāsūśca tataḥ parāatha kalpalatāstatra pañcakāmā tataḥ parāpañcabāṇeśvarī cā'tha paraṃjyotistataḥ parāiti kośeśvarīḥ praoktāḥ śṛṇu lakṣmīśvarīstataḥsāmrājyalakṣmīśca ramā ceti pañcakadevatāḥdadau samīpasaṃsthānaṃ binducakropari kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātaṅginyāśca vārāhyā dadāvatulasampadamvārāhyā daṇḍinītvañcaca duṣṭadaṇḍanehatutāmmadhyaṃ sthānaṃ dadau devī prasannā parisevanātkāmeśvarī ca vajreśī bhagamālinikā ca yāvāme ca dakṣiṇe pārśve sthānaṃ devyabhikalpayatsā prāpa tapasotkarṣādvajrasālā'ntare bhūvivajratneśvarītvañca tena vajreśvarī matāprāpustapasa ādhikyāttathā kāmeśvarī punaḥtathā'nyā api śaktistu mahātripurasundarīevaṃ navasu cakreṣu vibhatya vinive ya catripurā tripureśī ca tathā tripurasundarītripuramālinī tripurā siddhā tripurā'mbikātattadāvaraṇā'dyā'gre sthitā tatsadṛśā'kṛtiḥtathā brahmādibhirdṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ śaktigaṇā'vṛtamkāmeśa bhagavan deva tvamapi sṛja svāṃ'śataḥmanyāmahe śaktimahe śaktigaṇaṃ kevalaṃ viṣamantvitiubhayāṃ'śāttadanyasmādasṛjadvedasaṅkhyakānpustakā'bhītiaraciddadhānān sphaṭikaprabhānpadmā'sanasamāsīnān prasannavadanekṣaṇānpṛthagvidyāgurun yūyaṃ sṛjadhvamiti cā'bravīttṛtīyo mānavā'khyāṃstu gaṇānasṛjata kramātnāthānnavā'sṛjatturyaḥ kālamūrtīnmahāprabhāntaptvā prāpa sthānamapi tvaritā pṛṣṭhabhāgakedivyasiddhamānavaughaguruṇāṃ saṃsthitāni hipūrṇopāsanayogenopāsya śāstroktamārgataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti te pṛṣṭamākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mahatsaptapañcāśattmo'dhyāḥjagadvidhe! tvāṃ pṛcchāmi guravastvaugharupiṇaḥnāma teṣāñca sarveṣāmathā'gneḥ kuṇḍamīritamtatra kuṇḍe bhavadbhiśca strīrūpā kena hetunāna tṛpyāmyadbhutakathāṃ saṃśṛṇvannapi bhūriśaḥpibannapi ciraṃ daivahataṃ sthāṇumṛte kvacitśrutvā viśvakrtoktaṃ tat prasannaḥ prapitāmahaḥpārvatīṃ sarvato guptāṃ prasannaḥ prabruve tavavāgvidyāguravaḥ sarve svacchasaṃvittirupiṇaḥcaturvidhā śabdamayī parāśaktirvijṛmbhatetripurākhyā hi yā śaktiḥ svacchasaṃvedanāmayīsarvāstisārabhūtā'tmarūpī parameśvarīsarvā'śrayacitiḥ svacchā kevalā vāgagocarātadeva sarvasvātantryamato māyākhyamīritamsvayaṃ svātmānamamalaṃ vikalpayati bhūriśaḥvikalpa eva śabdātmā sthūlamadhyavibhedataḥtatra sthūlantu yadrūpaṃ vaikharīti prakīrtitamtallaukika'laukikatvādvidhā sarvatra saṃsthitaḥṣaḍjarṣabhau ca gāndhāramadhyapañcamadhaivatāḥrāgā'bhdibhūtā'gnidasranāgasaṃkhyāvibhedinaḥtadetaddevasaṃsthānaṃ guravaḥ saptasaṅkhyakāvyaktastvalaukiko vidyāmayaḥ kūṭacatuṣṭamsiddhaughaguravaḥ proktāḥ ṣaṣṭhīśapratibhāvitāḥtatsaṃśrayā mānavāḥ syuratastā vasusaṃkhyakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: auḍḍīśaprabhavā ete vasusaṃkhyāstu mānavāḥdhvanirāśiḥ samāyukto varaṇarāśyaṣṭakena cakālasyā'vachedakāste turīyapadasaṃśrayāḥsatyaḥ pūrṇaḥ svabhāvā'khyaḥ pratibhaḥ subhagā'bhidhaḥoghaścaturvidho vidyāvibhedādyugabhedataḥoghastu pañcamo'pi syādguruvidyāpravartakaḥvayaṃ divyabhāvāḥ siddhāḥ kumārādyāśca mānavāḥathā'gneścinmayatvaṃ te varṇayāmi kramācchṛṇutamaḥ kriyaḥ sattvamūrtirvikasaścinmayā'ntaraḥdakṣavāmamadhyasaṃsthaṃ paiṅgaleḍāsuṣumṇakambaddhaṃ madhyaṃ jñānamārgaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ rāhurāryakāḥkriyāmicchāṃ cetayati martyāstena hi cetanāḥāśrayībhūtacinmātrasyordhvavāhaśca cetanāḥna cetayanti te bhūtaṃ bhavyañca kvacidātmanievaṃ sthite mahādevo yastrinetrastato'dhikaḥtenā'ntarasmadvijñānaṃ pūrṇaṃ samupalakṣyatephāladeśe vinirbhinna madhyanāḍī cidātmikātasmāttannetrasambhūtaścidagniriti viśrutaḥśṛṇu loke viśvakarman yatsukhaṃ taccidātmakamsukhāvahaṃ sundarañcaloke pratyakṣabhāvanātsvavaibhavātmakaṃ viśvaṃ svātantryeṇa prakāśitamabhimāno vṛthā mohādahaṃ kartetisaṃsthitaḥtathā'pyasammataprāptirbhavedvā kathamīrayatasmādyoṣinmayadhyānaṃ tayaiva pravibhāvitamevaṃ sthitā mahārājñī cintāmaṇigṛhe tadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: matvā tadapi no samyaṅmahādevaḥ sadāśivḥbrahmāṇḍeṣu sthitā devā daityā martyādayo'pi yete tatra tattatsthāneṣu nivasanti pṛthak pṛthaktattadvaprāntarabhuvi svāmyaṃ prāpya sunirmalamviśanti paramaṃ bhāvamavāṅmanasagocarampūrvaṃ saṃsthitasāyujyaṃ labdhvā tiṣṭhanti sarvataḥbrahmāṇḍāntarasamprāptāḥ ṣaṣṭisāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥiti te sarvamākhyātaṃ mānaṃ śrīpurasaṃsthitamyatra śrīpurasāmrājñī tripurāmbā bhaviṣyatiiti dhātṛvacaḥ śrutvā viśvakarmā'tiviṣmitaḥvibhāvayan vidhiproktaṃ harṣanirbharitā'taraḥnāmā'ṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥkumbhodbhavaḥ prāha bhūyastatkathāśravaṇotsukaḥtapovighnaṃ nirjarāṇāṃ cikīrṣan vahninā'vṛtāntataḥ kimakarottatra tanme vada suvistarampunaḥ śrotuṃ samīhā me vardhate'titarāṃ nanuśṛṇu kumbhodbhava kathāṃ vicitrāṃ paramā'dbhutāmśūnyakaṃ pratyājagāma śaradabhrmivā'mbarātdadarśa vṛṣṭameghābhaṃ vādayan vallakīṃ śubhāmsampūjya vidhinā prāha kṛtāñjaliridaṃ cakṛpayā paśya śiṣyaṃ te durlabhaṃ te kṛpekṣaṇamprāyo viprā bhīravo hi gururme bhayamohitaḥdevāḥ śaktimupāsīnāḥ prasannā yadi sā bhavetityukto'haṃ daityagaṇaistatrā'yāto jighāṃsayāhṛṣṭaḥ pratyāgataḥ sthānaṃ tatra pṛcchāmi prastutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaścittatra vimukto vā tanme śaṃsamunīśvaradaityeśvarebhyo'sūyā me na kartavyā kadācanaprabhāṣase kathaṃ mugdha iva tvaṃ paṇḍito'pi sanśokasthāne harṣayuto yatastvaṃ vīkṣito mayāāvirbhūtā tvadvadhāya toṣitā śakramukhyakaiḥsarvalokeśvarī divyarūpā'dabhutamahābalāsameṣyati tvāṃ nihantuṃ kiṃ tuṣyasi hi mūḍhavatnūnaṃ mayā puraivoktaṃ viprāḥ prakṛtibhīravaḥviṣṇuḥ sureṣvatibalī sa yuddheme parājitaḥdevāsurādisraṣṭā'haṃ lokaśastrā'strasantateḥkathaṃ bhīto'si strīgetornisargādabalāḥ striyaḥdevarṣimānayamāsuravarodhe sakhīgaṇaiḥpādyā'rghyaiḥ subalidravyaiḥ praṇamya prāhurādarātvayamasmānnirīkṣasva dṛṣṭyā karuṇayā bhṛśamutpannā lalitā devī devaiḥ samabhipūjitātadbodhyā'surapatiṃ yathā nāśaṃ na caiṣyatiuddharā'smān duḥkhasindhoḥ pāhi naḥ paricārikāḥvīkṣya tāsāṃ praruditaṃ karuṇā'krāntamānasaḥdaityeśvara ! maduktaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu vākyaṃ sudhāsamamhitavaktā hi lokdeṣu janaḥ paramadurlabhaḥvadettamabhijānīyācchatruṃ mitrasvarupiṇamkaṭukaṃ hyauṣadhasamaṃ jānīyānmitrameva tamtaduktamatyantapathyaṃ rogiṇo bheṣjaṃ yathātadahaṃ prabravīmi tvāṃ yattaddaityapate śṛṇutatrā'pi śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kaiṭabho daityaśekharaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣṇunā nihato yuddhe'pratimo balaprauruṣeto'nayaiva parayā mahāsurabalairvṛtaḥna kiṃ smarasi gauryā te yuddhe pūrvaparābhavamsevyate yā'nekakoṭigaurīpramukhaśaktibhiḥyasya prasādādeva tvaṃ manyase balināṃ varamtadalaṃ svā'tmasarvārthanāśanā'bhiniveśataḥahaṃ tvāṃ tatra neṣyāmi parāśakteḥ padāntikamrājyaṃ prasādhi pātāle divaṃ śāsatu vāsavaḥna kariṣyasi matproktaṃ yadā yahi vinaṅkṣyasidhiyā sāttvikayā caitadvimṛśa svātmarakṣaṇamhastenā'dāya devarṣiṃ prārohat saudhaśekharamvātāyane maṇimaye viveśa mṛduviṣṭaredevarṣamayi roṣaṃ tvaṃ na śiṣye kartumarhasiyadbravīṣyakhilaṃ tatte nā'nyathā viditaṃ mayājānāsi sarvaṃ me vṛttaṃ līlayaivaṃ bravīṣi māmkadācit sā toṣaṇāya tripurāyā mahattapaḥkadācit kinnarī kācittāruṇyā'mṛtapūritāsroto'bhiruhyamānā sā trātāraṃ nā'dhigacchatatāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ samāropya taṭamāruhya sattvaramtadaṅgasparśanāścāhaṃ lāvaṇyasya samīkṣaṇātkalyāṇi tvaṃ rakṣitā'si mayā mṛtyormukhādivākṛte pratikṛtīṃ kuryācchaktaḥ sarvātmanā svayamtanmāṃ kāmāgninā'viṣṭamārtaṃ te śaraṇā'gatamśrutvā madviparītoktiṃ sādhvī sā kinnarī vacaḥmā buddhibhraṃśamāgaccha kinnarī patidevatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āste tasya priyā cā'smi tarucchāyeva saṅgatāya āpadbhyaḥ samuddhartā yaśca bālyaprapoṣakaḥtvaṃ te sutā dharmato'haṃ naivaṃ māṃ vaktumarhasināśayettaṃ manaḥ śīghraṃ mano yasya vaśe na histrīsukhaṃ sarvato hyekaṃ na viśeṣaḥ paśuṣvapipatibratānāṃ krodhāgniṃ prāpya mā bhasmatāṃ vrajāḥkāmamohaparītā'tmā parāmrṣṭumupadrutavadantī rakṣa rakṣeti tatastasyāstu sammukheathaṣṭvā'nayaṃ devī ramā kruddhā śaśāpa māmkṛtyaṃ tavā'suraṃ hye tattatastvamasuro bhavapratibuddhaḥ śokasindhunimagno'bhavamañjasāpunaḥ prāha ramādevī māṃ magnaṃ śokasāgareśariraṃ te ghorarūpaṃ paradārā'bhimarśanamevaṃ tayā praśapto'haṃ bhīto devīśriyaṃ tadāevaṃ cireṇa bhūyo'pi prasannā'bhavadambikāmāṇikyaśekhara ! kṛtaṃ tvyā'tyantavininditamnā'nyathā me bhavecchāpaḥ kṛtaṃ bhoktavyameva tekintu tāṃ patitāṃ toye dayayoddhṛtavānasiprāpyā'nekā'ṇḍanāthatvaṃ bhuktā bhogāna yathepsitānprāpya tatra ciraṃ kālamasuraiḥ pratipūjitaḥśrutvaitadvacanaṃ bhūyo hyapṛcchaṃ lokamātaramsā kiṃ tvatto'dhikā devī nā'haṃ jāne tavā'dhikāmityāpṛṣtā mayā devī prāha śrīlokamātṛkāmahācitisvarūpā sā yasyāḥ prakṛtidharmataḥīśavaro'pitirodhānakarastriguṇajeśvaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yasyā īkṣaṇaleśenā'nugrahādakhilaṃ sṛjetanugrahānmocayituṃ sṛjatyeṣa maheśvaraḥdehabhāvaṃ samāpannā sṛṣṭau jñātuṃ prabhāvitaḥsarvā'tmarūpā paramā citiśaktirudīritāsarvā'tmanā vṛṃhaṇena brahmaśabdena śabditāavāṅmanasagamyā sā cetyanirmuktacinmayīdve kale tasya nāthasya kāryatā kartṛteti caindriyāṇāntu daśakaṃ bhūtānāṃ pañcakaṃ tathākartṛtā syāt saptadaśī kalā nityā maheśituḥtāṃ hitvā na śivaḥkaścit brahmā vā'pi sadāśivaḥnara nāryaḥ prāṇijātaṃ jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathābhūṣaṇeṣu svaraṇamiva jalavat sāgarādiṣutejasyuṣṇaṃ yathā rūpaṃ jalespandoraso yathāsā svā'bhāsitalīlā'tmalokoddharaṇahetunājātā vayaṃ tadaṅgebhyo vākśrīgaurīsamāhvyāḥvacanāttu tathā jātā tārā bhairavasaṃyutākrauryāt pratyaṅgirodbhūtā mahāśarabhasaṃyutācaṇḍikā caṇḍaśabdena dhūmrā krūrekṣaṇena catasyā līlā'vatāreṇa lalitā'khyena saṅgareityuktastu tayā paścāt prārthanaṃ kṛtavān punaḥāsuratvaṃ bhavedyonisambandhena vinā mamana jātu māmiyaṃ prajñā jahātu jagadambike !tadahaṃ bhaktamūrdhanyāt kāmā'ṅgājjanimāptavānviṣayānuttamān bhuktvā nityañca cirakālataḥvastuṃ tasyāḥ samīpe'haṃ talloke kṛtaniścayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratīkṣāmi kadā'gatya vidhiṣyati ca māmititalloke nivasāmyāśu iti me tvarte manaḥiti śrutvā bhaṇḍavaco nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥjagāmā'bhimataṃ sthānaṃ nārado munisattamaḥkṛpāvaśāddevīdhāmaprāptivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥprasannaḥ prāha saṃhṛṣtaḥ svā'nubhūtanirūpaṇātmānasaṃ bāhyamapi ca mamā'sīdyat purātanamcirakālenā'ntaritamapyadyeva tavoktitaḥyatparākṛpayā sarvaṃ viditaṃ bhāhyamāntaramatītamāntaraṃ bhāhyaṃ kathate viditaṃ hyabhūtśrutvetthaṃ nāradavacaḥ prahasya hāritāyanaḥatropapattirapare khaṇde samyagbhaviṣyativareṇa brahmaṇaḥ sarvabāhyaṃ vā'pyāntaraṃ tathāsaṃsmarāmyavidagdhaṃnu śrīdevyāḥ suprasādataḥśṛṇu bhārgava ! tatpaścāddhāyā'syaḥ kumbhajanmaneśṛṇukumbhodbhava mune homā'gnijanitāṃ śivāmdṛṣṭvā śakramukhā devāścintayāmāsurāntarelatevā'lambarahitā bhartṛhīnā na śaobhatedadhyuḥ kāmeśvaraṃ yāvattāvatso'pi vinirgataḥdṛṣṭvā'nurūpa devyāste patirasyā varo mataḥtadvijñāya vidhimukhāḥ prārthya devīṃ parātparāmatha devaiḥ prārthitā sā lalitā parameśvarīsamastā'varaṇaughāṃśca smaraṇāt samavā'sṛjatpraṇamya daṇḍavaddevīṃ stutvā vividhasaṃstavaiḥdevyahaṃ samanuprāpto bhaṇḍadaityasya sannidhe

sanskrit: tadahaṃ preṣitastena tvāmāhā'surabhūpatiḥajñātvā madbalaṃ mugdhā vināśaṃ mā vrajā'dhunābhūyaḥ parājitānmatto māyāmātrasamāśritāndveyāt sukhaṃ mṛtyumukhapraviṣṭamiva sarvathāmanye'haṃ tvaṃ jitaprāyā tena dhīreṇa sāmpratamniśamya nāradoktiṃ tāṃ mantriṇīṃ samavekṣatakareṇā'dāya devarṣi rahasi prāviśat parāpṛccha nārada ! praṣṭavyaṃ yatte manasi vidyatenūnaṃ nā'viditaṃ te'sti loke śrīpādasaṃśrayātājñapta evaṃ mantriṇyā praṇamya suratāpasaḥdevī! bhaṇḍāsuro dṛṣṭo mayā samyak parīkṣitaḥkathaṃ yuddhe parābhūyāt parāpādaikasaṃśrayaḥciraṃ nivasya śrīloke tato gacchāmi tatpadamvayaṃkasmāllokagatiṃ vindāmastadubravīhi meśṛṇu me nārda ! vaco rahasyamapi sāmpratamtasyottamapadaprāptiḥ sarvathā syānna cā'nyathāna yacchati tathā pathyamauṣadhaṃ hyanapekṣitamtaṃ bhaktaśekharaṃ hatvā duṣkṛtaṃ vitataṃ kṛtamsvapadaṃ prāpayatyāśu tathā śṛṇu bravīmyahamtasmai tattripurā śighraṃ prayachati na saṃśayaḥtāvadeva tasya ciraṃ tataḥ sveṣṭamavāpnuyātajñasya tatsamīhā syāt jñasya vai tatkuto bhavettṛptaḥ kathaṃ bhuktimicchettava'nyo bhojayet kathamākāśasyeva pūrṇasya kiṃ prāptiḥ syāt kathaṃvada ?śrūtvetthaṃ nāarado mantriṇīproktaṃ hṛṣṭamanasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atha sā tripurā devī bhaṇḍā'suravadhaṃ praticakrarājasamakārarathe parvanavā'tmakeūrdhvabhūmau sthitā yuddhasambhāraughasusambhṛtāśastrā'stranicayopetā roṣā'ruṇitalocanāśastrāṇyastrāṇi ca tathā mūrtimanti sthitāni vaideśitāścitrakavacaiḥ śastrā'straiḥsupariṣkṛtāḥtaddkṣiṇe tu mantreśī saptaparvavirājiteśukādiśyāmalāvargaiḥ sevyamānā viniryayautathāvidhā'saṅkhyakoṭimātaṅgatanayā'vṛtāmantriṇī toṣayantyastā vilāsairhāsyamiśritaiḥtasyā mano'nukūleṣu mantreṣu niyataṃsthitāatha tadvāmato daṇṇdasāmrājñī śūkarā'nanāparivṛtā hyanekābhirjambhinyādisvaśaktibhiḥaparādhaparān sarvān daṇḍayantī sadā sthitāsthitābhyāṃ sīramusalamukhaśastraiśca śobhinīmtathā śrīlalitādeśyā bālā tripurasundarīnijāvṛttimahāśaktigaṇaiḥ parisamāvṛtāraṇakolāhalā'khyāne tridhā bhinne'tibhīṣaṇenisargamatte saṃruḍhā mahāṅkuśavidhāriṇīvindhyodbhavā malayajāḥ prāgjyotiṣasamudbhavāḥpraceluḥ sampadīśitrīparīvārasuśaktibhiḥtasyā śritā vāmabhāgamaśvāruḍhā maheśvarīgandharvajātijaṃ vāyujavanaṃ samadhiṣṭhitā"śuktyardhaśuktimaṇibhirdevasvastikapadmakaiḥsūkṣmā'vadhānato'pyasya na viduḥ khurasaṅgatim
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāmanvaśvā asaṃkhyeyāḥ sindhuṭaṅkaṇambhavāḥśoṇāḥ śyāmāḥ sitāḥ pītāḥ kapilāḥ pāṭalāstathāvicitrāścārusarvāṅgā ghanakesaramaṇḍanāḥvicitraśastrā'stradharaśaktibhiḥ samādhiṣṭhitāḥdārayanto'vanimiva khurakṣepairviniryayuḥdveṣitasvanasaṅghātairgajacītkāramiśritaiḥjayabheraīravairmṛṇḍḍmṛdaṅgajhallarīravaiḥmiśritaḥ śrīcakrarājarathanemigaṇodbhavaḥśrūtvā śrīlalitādevyā yaitrayātrāmahāsvanambhaṇḍadaityaḥ svātmavadhaṃ cirābhilaṣitaṃ tayāatha daityān samālokya trastān śuṣyanmukhāmabujānnūnaṃ hīme mama kṛte vinaśyanti sabāndhavāḥmatkṛte nihatānetān śociṣyanti priyātmajāḥtadahaṃ purato gatvā yuddhvā śrīlalitāmbayāśocayāmi kutastvetā viyojya svasvabāndhavaiḥśakto'rakṣan svīyajanaṃ śokasthānāt kathañcanaathaivaṃ mayi nirtya prāpte devyā nijā'tyayamkathaṃ mayi hate devatrāsanā mama bāndhavābhaviṣyanti śucā hīnā na caitadapi sammatamnūnāṃ mayi hate devyā bhrātṛputrādibāndhavaḥyudhā'gnau svātmaśalabhān bhasmīkuryurna saṃśayaḥdevā iva dainyabhājo viyutāḥ strīsutādibhiḥārodanantu bandhūnā nāastīti na kathañcanaādau devyā hateṣveṣu tato'hamabhavaṃhataḥpāvanaṃdevatāśastraiḥ prāptirlokottamasya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atrā'pi manye strībālamukhānāṃ n hi sambhavamatha vaitanmayā pūrvaṃ śrutamabjāsanānmukhātiti tanme parīvāraṃ na śoṣayatu sā parājānānasyā'pi me devī mohamutpādayatyalamtattaṃ sarveṇa bhāvena śaraṇaṃ prāptavānahampāhi māṃ parameśāni śaraṇye ! śaraṇāgatamiti prārthya mahādevīṃ tripurāṃ bhaṇḍadānavaḥharṣayanniti hovāca parākramayutaṃ vacaḥna me mṛyuḥ kuto'pyasti mṛtyormṛtyurahaṃ yathasacarā'caralokānāṃ sraṣṭā'haṃ vaḥ samakṣataḥtatremāmabalāṃ jñātvā na śīghraṃ hantumutshesvā'ntaḥ puraṃ samānīya mahā'nandamuṣaimyalambhaṇṇdāsurasyohāmapohavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥbabhāṣe krodhatāmrākṣo rathaḥ saṃyujyatāmitinivedayaddaityanāthe praṇamyā'tivinītavatgṛhītvā saśaraṃ cāpaṃ pracacālā'tiroṣitaḥdaityā viniryayuḥ śīghraṃ sannaddhāḥ krodhamūrchitāḥniryayurdaityasubhaṭāḥ saṅghaśo dhṛtahetayaḥkuṭilākṣo'grajasteṣāmameyabalavikramaḥakṣauhiṇīśatayutā bhaṇḍadaityā'grato yayuḥpārśvayordaityparājasya viṣaṅgaśca viśukrakaḥrathasthau tau mahācāpau krudhā'ruṇitalocanaupratyekamakṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatena parivāritauanujagmurdaityapariṃ śatā'kṣauhiṇisaṃyutāḥrarāja rājapathyā tu prāvṛṭkālanadī yathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: turaṅgabhaṅgā dviradagrāhā kheṭakakacchapīkhaḍgadīrghamahāsarpā tūṇimatsyavicitritāvicitracchatrahaṃsādipatatritatimālinīrathaghoṣamahāghoṣā vāhiṇī jalavāhinīkulyāmukhājjalaṃ hyāśu kedāre prasṛtaṃ yathātadantre tu vijayaḥ prāpya daityeśvaraṃ drutamprāpyā'jñāmavadattaṃ suvacastatkālasammatampratāpatapanaścordhve brahmāṇḍāni tapatyasauso'pi tvatsammukhaṃ prāpya yudde bhūyaḥ parājitaḥtathā'pi mantriṇā kāle cār'thaśāstrapramāṇataḥkāle yuktamanuktvā tu na sumantritvamarhatitatraikiao'pi sve kāle sammato balavattaraḥnaśyedasadṛśaṃ bhuktvā hyāmayīvā'gadaṃ nṛpaḥdṛṣṭvā yuddhaṃ tena śreyaḥsamāpnuyāttāvat senā'pi sannddhā bhaviṣyatyaviśaṅkitāvijñaptavyamidaṃ kāle mayā te svāminaḥ puraḥniśamya mantrivākyaṃ tadyuktaṃ kuśalasammatamniveśya senāpatibhiḥ senāṃ tatra vibhāgaśaḥamitraghnaṃ mantrivaryaṃ prāha bhaṇḍamahā'suraḥnā'haṃ tvāṃ sundarīṃ devīṃ sarvathā saṃśrayocitāmyuddhaśraddhā taveyaṃ vai sammtaṃ mama sarvathākintvahaṃ tvāṃ priyākārāṃ dṛṣṭvā drutaṃ manobhavāmsāmnā yuddhena vā'pi tvāṃ karomyātmasamāśrayāmvimṛśyaitaddrutataraṃ pakṣamekataraṃ bhajabalañcasarvaṃ tatkṛtyaṃ jñatvāa yāhi druta punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidyunmālinmahāprājña māyāvikulanāyakabalañca vyavasāyañca bhedacchidrāṇi yuktitaḥājñaptāvitarau daityau yayatuḥ śaktivāhinīmamitraghno mahāsenāṃ viveśā'bdhiṃ yathā plavaḥpraviṣṭamātraṃ śaktyā sa gṛhīto balavattaraḥcapeṭayā nihatyā'śu gṛhītvā taṃ gale'suramkastvaṃ senāmimāṃ devyā daṇḍarājñīsurakṣitāmājñāṃ vinā daṇḍarājñyāḥ praviṣṭo vāhinīmimāmtadantare tu samprāptāḥ sainyarakṣāniyojitāḥprabalābhiḥ samākṛṣṭo nihato mūrcchito'bhavatsamakṣaṃ hyānayāmāsa svaparīcāraśaktibhiḥvijñāpya mantriṇī devyāḥ samīpamānayattataḥnītvā papraccha dūtaṃ taṃ kṛtyaṃ tatrā'gamasya hidūto'haṃ tasya daityasya taduktaṃ saṃbravīmyahamyuddhvāvā'pyayuddhvāvā vā devi bhūyāstvaṃ matsamāśrayātaddevān samparityajya bhava tvaṃ matsamāśrayāityahaṃ preṣitastena dūtabadhyā [dhaḥ] vininditā [naḥ]iti matvā praviṣṭo'haṃ lakṣaitaḥ sarvaśaktibhiḥānītaste samakṣañcetyetat sarvaṃ nirupitamniśamya dūtavacanaṃ lalitāyā mataṃ tataḥmābhairdaitya vraja sukhaṃ hanyase na kadācanayadi te jīvane śraddhā drutamāgatya nirbhayaḥtrilokeśo bhavedindra tvaṃ pātāle nivatsyasianyathā na vimokṣaste jīvan kvā'pi bhaviṣyatidarśayitvā tataḥ senabahirenaṃ visarjaya
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyasarjayattaṃ daiteyaṃ bahiḥ senāniveśanātjagāma rājasavidhaṃ bhayavihvalitā'ntaraḥbhīto rātrau mahāmāyaḥ kauśikiṃ tanumāśritaḥgaṇayitvā sarvasenāṃ brajantaṃ gaganā'dhvanaḥgṛhītamātro māyāvī proḍḍīya gaganordhvataḥciraṃ yuddhvā śūlahatastayā muktaḥ kathañcanapapāta puratastasya sūryasyodayanaṃ pratibhaṇḍāsuro japanmantraṃ pasparśā'ṅgeṣu pāṇināutthāya praṇanāmā'śu daityarājaṃ puraḥsthitammahārāja tvatsamakṣaṃ gato'mitraghnasaṃyutamathā'mitraghna evā'dau praviveśa mahācamūmmadhuvanmakṣikābhiḥ sa samākrānto'tha śaktibhiḥaśaktaḥ spanditumapi kva yuddhaṃ kva palāyanamtāvadbhīto'pyahaṃ durāt palāyanaparo'bhavamtato dinā'vasāne'haṃ māyāghūkatvamāsthitaḥsā senā mahatī dṛṣṭā bhīmā bhīṣaṇanādinīdarśanadeva senāyā yasyanti mṛtimāsurāḥahampūrvikayā yaddhaṃ kartumādau samutsukāḥkumāribhiḥ koṭiśatasaṃkhyābhiḥ parivāritābhaṇḍaputrān nihanmīti sā bravīti punaḥ punaḥnāśayāmaḥ kṣaṇenā'tigarjantyaḥ samarotsukāḥgajānaśvānasaṃkhyātān mahāśaktibhirāsthitānatha bālā pṛṣṭhatastu mahārathanivāsinīaprameyabalakrauryaśaurthayuktābhirāvṛtāpratyekaṃ rathamāruḍhā mahā'dbhutaparākramā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: citravīryābhirabhitaḥ saṃvṛtāmantriṇī sthitāśaktibhirbaṭukādyaśca saṃyutā'tiruṣānvitāyatra te vadhavṛttāntasaṅgatirna hi saṃstutānāśayediti me buddhirvyavasāyaṃ samāsthitāsenaivaṃ śaktinicitā daityarāja ! vadāmi tesarvān daityagaṇānasmānatitiṣṭhati sarvathāvidyunmālī samabhavattūṣṇī daityasabhāgataḥbhaṇḍāsurā'ṅghyrorapatad bhayavihvalitāntarammahārāja tvadājñapto gataḥ śaktimahācamūmna me vīryaṃ balaṃ vāpi babhau śaktyagrataḥ kvacitkṣanena tāsāṃ grahaṇādvisaṃjño'bhavamañjasāsā kulādririvonnamrā kroḍāsyā kāñcanaprabhātādṛgvidhaṃ śaktigaṇaṃ tasyāḥ krodhapradīpitamtasyā niyogānnito'haṃ śaktibhirmantriṇīpuraḥsaundaryakulasāraṅgī pūrṇatāruṇyagarvitāgītahāsyaparā nityaṃ viṇāvādananiṣṭhitāanvavekṣamahaṃ sarvasaubhāgyaikasamāśrayāmtayā nīto mahārājñyāḥ samakṣamahamāśvathasandeśaṃ vācayanmahyaṃ yattatte mantriṇīmukhātbrūyāstaṃ bhaṇḍadaityeśaṃ jīvane yadi te matiḥnivasa tvaṃ parīvārayutaḥ pātālasadmaniakṛtvaivaṃ na te mokṣo lokā'ntaragatasya caiti tvayā tatra gatvā vaktvyo bhaṇdadānavaḥkarālakaravālodyatkarā tatra samāyayaumantranātāñca vṛtāntaṃ babhāṣe sā'nuyojitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madbhṛtyāḥ śaktyo gatvā dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ samāgatāḥiti vṛttaṃ tayā proktaṃ sarvamasmatsamāśrayamna tayā'viditaṃ kiñcinā'sti bāhyā'ntareṣu camantraste mantrito'pyatra nā'smābhirvidito'pi yaḥcitraṃ manye cirādatra vasannaviditañca yatyattvayā'pyatra no jñātaṃ tattvayā kathitaṃ nanuekā'pi śaktiravarā sarvanno nāśayet kṣaṇātendrādayo'pi vijitā mayā bhūyaḥ samāgamegṛhīto līlayaivā'śu hariṇā mṛgaśāvavatgṛhaṇantyahaṃ tathā tābhirgṛhīto balavānapiaśakyaṃ sarvathā daityairjetuṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥśrutvetthaṃ daityavacanaṃ bhaṇḍaḥ svā'ntaracintayatprasādamakarodadya cirakālā'bhikāṅkṣitamdhanyo'haṃ tripureśānīṃ dṛṣṭvā yuddhe'nubhāṣya cavrajāmi lallokamamuṃ mahāsukhasamāśrayamdaityasvabhāvavihitaścirabhārāyito nanutathā'haṃ duḥkhadaṃ dehamamuṃbhāraṃ visṛjya tununaṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ niyutairdaha eṣa meta eva bhogāstadrājyaṃ tāḥ striyastaśca saṅgatamnirviṇṇo'haṃ dṛḍhataramasmāt paryuṣitātmanaḥparantu me virahitāḥ śociṣyanti priyā emeādau vā'nantaraṃ vā'pi duḥkhadaia mṛtirbhavetevaṃ me tripurā devī kṛpāṃ kuryādabhīpsitāmbhaktavāñchāsamadhikaphaladā sā nisargataḥitthaṃ vicintya manasā namaskṛtya parāmbikām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parasaṃślāghanaṃ yattalloke kāpuruṣabratambalīvāpyabalo vā'pi śūrāstatra na bibhyativamanniva netramukhāt krodhakākolapāvakampaśyantu daityā ye bhītāḥ tasyāmeti parākramamvadantameva daityeśaṃ sūtaḥ sarathamagrataḥtaṃ menire janāḥ kālaṃ jagatsaṃharaṇodyatamityūcuḥ sahasā sarve bhītāśacā'surapuṅgavāḥputrāḥ pautrāśca bhrātaraḥ sarvaḥ eva teathā'jñpto viśukreṇa kuṭilākṣaśca bhūpatiḥtannivedya viśukrāya vikarṣanmahaīṃ camūmevaṃ pracalite daityarāje nikhilasenayāpaṭahā'nakabherīṇāṃ vādyairddaityavigarjanaiḥvandimāgadhasannādairhayadneṣitavṛṃhitaiḥhuṅkṛtā'hvānasaṃrāvaiḥ saṃhato hi mahāsvanaḥsenāsvanaṃ samākarṇya bhaṇḍadaityasamāgamamdaṇḍinī tvaritā mantranāthāṃ prāpya vyajijñapatmahāsannāhasambhāro yuddhaṃ mahadupasthitamsaṃrakṣantī śaktigaṇairmahārājñyā anuvrajaeṣa śabdaḥ śrūyate vai gajavājisamākulaḥsampannāthā'śvanāthābhyāṃ yutā citraparākramāvardhayitvā daṇḍanāthāṃmantriṇīñcā'pyabhāṣatadaityarājasya sannāho mahān yuddhasamudyamaḥsamāgataḥ krurataro yudyatikrūravikramaḥkiṃ vadāmi punargatvā tāṃ devīṃ gajavāhinīmprāha tatkālasadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ vikramabṛṃhitam

sanskrit: apramattatayā nūnaṃyoddhavyaṃ daityapuṅgavaiḥsarvataḥ sā rakṣitavyā prāptā'smyahamapi drutamtathā saṃrudhya yoddhavyaṃ yāvanmama samāgamaḥnāśayāmi kṣaṇenaiva tamaḥ sūryodaye yathāājñaptaiva nirgatā sā śaktiḥ sandeśahāriṇīasaṅkhyaśaktisenābhiryutā krodhasamākulādidhakṣantīva lokāṃśca sarvān roṣāgninā kṣaṇātpareṣāṃ hṛdayaṃ bhindan śrotramārgeṇa saṃviśanevaṃ śrīdaṇḍasāmrājñī jaitrayātrāmupā'kramatbālayā yuddhodyogavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥniśmya praikṣadatyantayuddhotsukatayā diśamdadarśa daityasenāyāḥ sammardajanitaṃ rajaḥjñātvā prāptaṃ daityarājaṃ sarvasenāsamāvṛtamlaghucakrarathā'ruḍhā rathanetrīmacodayatadṛṣṭvaiva mahādevīṃ mantriṇīmabhisaṃyayaudaityasenā'bhimukhato vāyuvegena saṃyayauaśvāruḍhā drutataraṃ tāmanu pratisaṃyayauupādravajjagajjvālāplāvanāyeva sarvataḥanekakoṭimātaṅgasenāsaṃvalitā drutamnoditā śīghrasaṃyāne rathavidyāviśāradāprāvṛṇnadīva jaladhiṃdaityasenāṃ vyavagāhatanadīvegavibhinne'bdhau nauriva syandanantu tatkuṭilākṣo daityasenāmukhe kuñjarasaṃsthitaḥdaityasenāpatiḥ so'pi dṛṣṭvā bālāṃ kumārikāmekākinīṃ rathāruḍhāṃ mṛdvaṅgīmaṣṭahāyanām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirbhayā yodhayatyasmānindrādīnāñcatrāsanānlakṣaye sarvacihnāni kintveṣā taruṇī na cakathaṃ tattanayā bālā senāvirahitā punaḥnūnameṣaiva sarvānno jeṣyatīva vibhāti meviśukro vā viṣaṅgo vā rājā vā'ṣyahameva vāasmatsenā yatra nirīkṣati tatastataḥkoṭiśo nihatā daityāstrāsitā'smanmahācamuḥpatitāśca mṛtāścā'nye dhāvantyanye mahābhayātpatitāstatra śataśo nimagnā raktasindhuṣuroddhavyeyaṃ mayā yatnāddhiṅmāmevaṃvidhaṃsthitamnaitadindreṇa marutā vāyunā'pi kṛtaṃ purāiti niścatya tāṃ roddhuṃ mahāgajasamāsthitaḥyuyodhā'tibalo daityaḥ kuṣtilākṣastayā sahavavarṣa śaravarṣeṇa bālāṃ yuddhe'grataḥsthitāmsā'pi bālā'ruṇā'bhāṅgī śaratīkṣṇatarāṃ'śubhiḥardayāmāsa daityasya senāṃ niśitasāyakaiḥna veda kaścitkuśalo'pyatisūkṣamadṛśā'pi caprāvṛṅgirimukhāttoyādhāramiva nirantarāmkuṭilākṣaṃ samāsādya jaghān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥtasya śastrā'srajālāni pratiśastrā'stravarṣataḥekena tīkṣṇabhallena cāpaṃ tasyā'cchinajjavātiṣuṇā tāḍito vaktre girirājasamo gajaḥmariṣyantamibhaṃ jñātvā kuṭilākṣo gadādharaḥāyāntamativegena gadāhastaṃ niśāmya sāsa viddhastīkṣṇabāṇena bahuśoṇitamudgiran
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atha bālā prāha sakhīṃ rathanetrīṃ smitā'nanāāyātyeṣā pṛṣṭhato me daṇḍinī śūkaradhvajāmāmāsādya daṇḍanāthā pratirotsyati vai dhruvamityuktā rathanetrī sā bālāṃ proce sakhī tadādṛśyate kāñcanamayo rathastasyaiṣa eva himahārathibhiratyugraḥ saṃvṛto nanu dṛśyateśastreṇa sṛja mārgaṃ tvaṃ vāhayāmi tato rathamśaravṛṣṭyā nimeṣeṇa daityasenāsu madhyataḥsenāmukhaṃ mahāśūrairdaityairuddhamapi kṣaṇātashyāṃ śaradhārāṃ tāṃ prāpya daityāḥ pradudruvuḥtathā'nye śastrasaṅghātapātena tilaśaḥ kṛtāḥsuphenilāstaraṅgaḍhyā uṣṇokakavahā evaandhībhūtā na viditā daityairvidrāvatatparaiḥpatanti saṅghaśastatra daityānāṃ mastakānyalamhā tāta putra susakhe bhrātarmitra hato'smyahamtadantare mukhe bhagne senāyāstasya vegataḥviśukradaityo'varajo bhaṇḍadaityasya saṃyugegacchantīṃ daitarājena yoddhumutsukitāṃ tadāniḥsīmabalavīryā'ḍhyā yudhyatyativicitritamtathā'pi samare śūrairyoddhavyaṃ sarvathā nanukiṃ kariṣyati sā devī lalitā samare punaḥiti niścitya nāgendramairāvatakulodbhavamrurodha bālāṃ rathagāṃ praviśya daityavāhinīmsaṃrudhya śaravarṣeṇa shiṃhanādamatha'karotdaityā naitatsamaṃ yuddhe kulajānāṃ palāyanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āhārya vīryaṃ krodhañca nivartadhvaṃ samantataḥkiṃ vakṣyatha gṛhe stribhiḥ pṛṣṭā yudhānnivartaneviśukravacanaṃ śrutvā parāvṛttastatastu tedaityasenābhirākrāntāḥ sā bālā rathasaṃsthitāatha tāṃ rathanetrīṃ sā sakhī prāha priyaṃvadāna te pārṣṇigrahā kāciścakragoptryadhividyaterathaṃ nivartayāmyeṣā senāyuktā punardrutamsrutvā sakhīvacaḥ prāha prahasya mṛdubhāṣiṇīparyāptā me daityasenā yudhyantyā yudhi me dvacitmanyase cedimaṃ paśya kṣaṇaṃ nirdaityalokakamdevi nāstyeva me bhītiḥ sainye'pītaḥ "śatottareśaṅke śrīlitādevyā yadājñāmantarā tvayābrūhi śīghraṃ rathamahaṃ kvanayāmi raṇā'vanautriṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥprāha śighraṃ naya rathaṃ yatrā'sau gajasaṃśrayaḥityājñptā kṣaṇādeva nināya syandanottamamśarasantatidhārābhiścakre'tiśithilāṃ tadāhatāstatra mahādaityāḥ kuliśā'streṇa sarvataḥekabāhvakṣicaraṇapārśsvībhūtāstathā pareniśāmya prāhiṇonnāgamairāvatakulodbhavamvavarṣa śaradhārābhirmaṇiśṛṅgamivā'mbudaḥśaravarsaṃ dvayaṃ tattu tamobhūtaṃ raṇā'vanaujaghānā'karṇapūrṇena haste tāṃ rathavāhinīmtdadṛṣṭvā roṣatāmrākṣī garjantaṃ daityapuṅgavambhallārdito gāḍhamūrcchāṃ viśukraḥ prāpatadgataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atha bālā kṣaṇenaiva laghuhastakriyā'nvitāathaikenā'karṇaśareṇa nataparvaṇāindrāyudhaṃ girimiva dadāra sa śaro gajamsaṃchinnaḥ krakaceneva mahāsthāṇurbabhau gajaḥkhaḍgahastaḥ khamutpatya tāṃ prahartumupadrutaḥlāghavenaiva sā bālā dūrādekena patriṇāviśukramūrghni tanmagnaṃ kiñcidbāṇatrayaṃ yadāgāḍhaviddho'pi dhairyeṇa pakṣirāḍiva vegavānniśāmya hviyamāṇāṃ tāṃ rathanetryabravīdidadmjahi vīryeṇa daiteyaṃ yāvaddūraṃ na gacchatinirvartya muṣṭiṃ sudṛḍhāṃ pātayattasya mūrdhnigāḍhamūrchāsamāviṣṭo nipapāta mahītalepriye śighraṃ naya rathameṣo'gre daityanāyakaḥyathā nīlagirirhasairjalanirjharasaṃvṛtaḥeṣā pṛṣṭhato me daṇḍanāthā camūvṛtāavaśyaṃ mama yuddhasya vihatiṃ sā kariṣyatiutkaṇṭhitā'smi tadyuddhe sarvathā naya māṃ drutamyāvadbhaṇḍasya puratastāvadrathavarā'śrayaḥanayā yuddhyamānasya daityarājasya sarvathātadā cirārjitā kīrtirvyarthaṃ hīyeta sarvathātasmādatra yathāśaktyā yatitavyaṃ bhavenmayāāyāntaṃ sammukhaṃ daityaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathavarasthitampriye! bhaṇḍena yoddhavye mahān vighno hyupasthitaḥityuktvā niśitān bāṇāṃścaturo visasarja haathaikena dhvajaṃ chittvā sūtamekena patriṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: moghaṃ sodyogamālakṣya turaṅgā'ntarasaṃśrayaḥturageṇa samāyāntaṃ vātanunnā'bhrakhaṇḍavatśaravarṣamagaṇayannāyāntamābhimukhyataḥakarodbyasumaśva taṃ hatāśvo'th viṣaṅgakaḥsamudramiva garjantaṃ kālāntakayamopamamsa gāḍhaviddho bāṇena bhramannuṣṇamasṛgvamantadadbhutaṃ karma dṛṣṭvā daityā devāśca vismitāḥbahudhā hyajayadyuddhe viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥsarvān vijeṣyatyeṣaiva lalitā kiṃ kariṣyatibhaṇḍāsurasamakṣaṃ stvaṃ dṛṣtvā bālā mahāsuramanena yuddhvā santuṣye cirābhilaṣitantvataḥatha bhaṇḍāsuro dṛṣṭvā bālāṃ sammukhasaṅgatāmsa kāla eṣa samprāptaḥ śriyoktaściravāñchitaḥnūnameṣaḥ kṣaṇo me'dya ghoradehaviyojakaḥeṣā śrīlalitārājñyāḥ kumārdbhutavikramāmāṃ nihantuṃ sā'pi devi ramāvacanagauravātbhavatvenāṃ pūjayāmi tadabimbādutthitā'tmikāmitthaṃ vicintya saśaraṃ jagrāha sudṛḍhaṃ dhanuḥathā'paraṃ pauṣpamantramantritaṃ mūrdhani kṣipatśaro'paro mūrghni tasyā mālāvarṣamavā'kiratkumāryetanmahaścitraṃ prapaśyāmyasureśvaretvayi varṣaṃ kirantyāṃ vai śarāṇāmāhavā'vanauahaṃ saṃśayayuktā'smi tanme dūrikuru drutampurā śrutaṃ yallalitā proktamatyantagūhitamśāpena daityatāṃ prāptastripurābhaktaśekharaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māṃ matvā lalitāputrīṃ pūjayāmāsa sāyakaiḥsa śaraḥ pañcaśākhātmā pasparśa tasya mūrdhaniprasādamakaroddevī ceti saṃhṛṣito'bhavatathā'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ kumārībhaṇḍadaityayoḥdvandvabhūtamanupamaṃ dvairathyaṃ śaravarṣaṇamdevīṃ santoṣayāmīti yuyodha balavattaramjñātvā'nyonyaṃ śastrayogalāghavaṃ ślāghanāparauityevaṃ yudhyatostatra kumārībhaṇḍadaityayoḥkuliśā'straṃ pārvatasya nāgā'strasya ca gāruḍamtasya sārpaṃ tasya punarnākulaṃ tasya caiva himahāvyāghraṃ mṛgenadrañca tasya śārabhamastrakamkauberaṃ naiṛtañcaindraṃ raudraṃ mohanameva cayuddhamāsīnmahāghoraṃ kumārībhaṇḍadaityayauprekṣāñcakrurvicitreṇa yuddhenā'tyantavismitāḥhīyamānaḥ samabhavadbhaṇḍadaityo yadā tadāsaṃvṛttā daityasenābhiḥ parivārya kumārikāmbālāpi tān līlayaiva yodhayāmāsa sarvataḥsamprāptā daṇḍasamrājñī jitvā daityamahācamūmmusalātmamahāvajrā'yudhena krūravikramāyudhyantīmekalāṃ daityaiḥ pa"yantī vismitā tadābālāparākramavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥviśīrṇā parvata iva devendrā'yudhagauravātviśīrṇāyāmapaśyat sā bālāṃ daityaiḥ susaṅgatāmsamarotsukitāṃ bhūyo dṛṣṭvā viṣmayamāgamatalaṃ bāle sāhasena yuddhena viṣameṇa te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daityānmahābalān bhīmān saṃyuge jitavatyasiśrīdevī vatsalā nūnaṃ bhavedvyākulitāntarāityuktā'jñāpayacchaktimaśvasenā'dhināyikāmmahārājñyeai nivedyaināmāgaccha tvaritaṃ punaḥbālāyā rathāaviśya nyavartayata taṃ rathammātareṣā yuddhabhuvo balātkārānnivartitātvadājñāyā vayaṃ yāvadenāṃ yuddhānnivartitumpraviṣṭā tatra daityānāṃ koṭayo balāttarāḥnirjitau bhīmacāritrau tau viśukraviṣaṅgakauyuddhvā tenā'pi suciraṃ jitamāyaṃ cakāra vaiityuktvā niryayau sā'pi yudhāya turaśā'śrayāpariṣvajyā'tivātsalyānmūrdhnyu pājighradambikāanuktvaiva gatā yuddhe naitadaupayikaṃ tavaeṣā'ruṇitanetrāntā niḥśvasantī punaḥ punaḥśaṅkamānā tvayā tatra vighnaṃ naitamavedayamtāvakyā daṇḍarājñā'haṃ vṛthaiva samarāṅgaṇātanyathā sā'pi madyuddhaṃ vimadā prāpya vai bhavetmaivaṃ vatse ! punabrūryā ityuktvā sāntvayat parāyuyodha bhaṇḍadaityena yutena daityasenayākrodhā'veśasamāyuktā praviṣṭā'bhūtparasparamnārācairbhindipālaiśa khaḍgaśūlaparaśvadhaiḥjaghnuryuddhe mahābhīme marṣitā balavattarāḥkeciddvidhā krṭāḥśastraiḥ kecittu tilaśaḥ krṭāḥkrandantaḥ putra mitreti hā bhrātastāta ityapidaityāḥ śiṣṭāḥ suvitrastāḥ palāyanaparāstadā

sanskrit: śoṇitodā vavurnadyaḥ phenilā bhīṣaṇasvanāḥevaṃ vinihataprāyāṃ daityasenāmupadrutāmpunastatrā'bhavadyuddhaṃ krūraṃ śaktigaṇaiḥsahasasarja māyayā dhvāntaṃ tatra varṣa śilāmayamvitrāsitā mūrcchitā cā'pyabhavadbhīmasaṛavāviśukreṇa mahāyuddhe saṅgatā'tidrutaṃ babhauvārāhī bhaṇḍadaityena yuyodhā'tiruṣā'nvitāasaṅkhyagajasainyena yutā sampatkarī parāvavarṣa śaravarṣeṇa viśukraṃ māyayā yutamprativarṣeṇa daityo'pi vavarṣa viśikhātmanāso'pyanyadādade cāpaṃtañcā'pyeṣā samācchinatathā'tikrodhasaṃyukto viśukro'dbhutavikramaḥbhallā'hatabhujāttasyā nyapatattanmahaddhanuḥjagarja patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā hastāścāpaṃ mahattaramtayorabhūnmahadyuddhaṃ kariṇoragayorivadantā'kramairmahāśabdairmuhūrtamatibhīṣaṇamākramya bhūmau vegena nipātya radanadvayamevaṃ nikṣiptamātrastu cītkurvan kuñjaradhipaḥpatantaṃ bāhanebhantamālakṣya sa mahāsuraḥprāharat kumbhayormadhye sarvaprāṇena roṣitaḥapā'sarat pañcadhanurmātraṃ cītkārabhairavaḥtameva vāhanaṃ tasyā sampatkaryā yuyodha hababhañja tad dvidhā madhye samādāyaikakhaṇḍakamevaṃ hatā sā balavadīṣatkaśmalamāgatāmūrdhni tasya viśukrasya ruṣā sampatakarī balāt

sanskrit: kṛttapakṣaḥ śaila iva patāta vasudhātaleālakṣya tadbhaṇḍasutaḥ yudhyamānaḥ samīpataḥevaṃ parājitaḥ sampannāthayā sa mahāsuraḥvividhairastraśastraiśca yudhyantaṃ taṃ mahāsuramtāḍito gadayā ceṣanmūrcchāṃ prāpya punarjavātsamādāyā'śvasenāsu vicacārā'ntakopamaḥchinnamūrdhāṅgacaraṇāḥ prapetuḥ saṅghasaṅghaśaḥbaddhvā pāśena gadayā sā'śvaṃ hantuṃ samudyatāantardhānaṃ yayau sāśvomāyayā māyināṃ guruḥdaṇḍanāthā ca bhaṇḍena yuyodha balasambhṛtāparākrameṇā'kramata bhaṇḍāṃ kolamukhī yudhimuṣṭiyuddhe ca daityeśamatyaricyata daṇḍinīmāyāṃ prāduścakāroścairmāyināṃ śekharo'suraḥśilāvarṣaṃsarpavarṣañca pāvakamsiṃhāṃśca śarabhānāṇḍabheruṇḍānasṛjadyudhipratikriyā'strasandhānairnāśayāmāsa sarvataḥnabhasyantarhito bhūtvā yuyodha saratho'suraḥśastrā'śanigaṇopetaṃ śaktisenābhayaṃkarambhinnasetudakamiva viluptā'bhūt samantataḥutpapātā'tivegena sāyudhā nabhaso'ṅgaṇammṛgayāmāsa daityeśaṃ nabhasyandhatamovṛteapahatya mahāmāyāmāsasāda mahāsuramgadayā'bhyāhananmūrghni vajrā'hata ivā'drirāṭapunaḥ sā gadayaivā'śu rathamaśvāṃśca sārathimtāvanmūrcchāvinirmukto gadāhasto hāsuraḥ

sanskrit: athā'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ vārāhīdaityarājayoḥmuhūrtamātraṃ yuddhvaivaṃ balotasiktaṃ mahāsuramtāvanmatvā nijātmānaṃ hataṃ musalaghātataḥnūnaṃ proktaṃ ramādevyā yat purā na tadanyathātripurā sā mahādevī bhaktavāñchitapūraṇīdaitye vicintayatyevamabhavannābhasaṃ vacaḥamogho musalaste'yaṃ sannivarya vai drutammocayattaṃ sīragarbhānmatvā'vadhyaṃ sureśvaramdaityasenāśaktigaṇairgāḍhaviddhā palāyitālalitāyai śaktisenāṃ samavāpyā'bhitaḥ sthitāmajīvayadvirujayat tato hṛṣṭāñca tāṃ camūmpuro'vrajadaśvanāthā senayā daṇḍanāyikāgajavāditraśabdaughaiḥ khyāpayantī svakaṃ jayambhaṇḍāsuraparābhavo nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥāsādya mantriṇīṃ devīṃ praṇamya jayamādiśatatha gatvā tayā sārdhaṃ mahārājñīṃ praṇamya cabhaṇḍāsuro'pi daityānāṃsenayā naṣṭaśeṣayāśūnyakaṃ nagaraṃ prāpya jagāmā'ntaḥpuraṃ svakambrūyurnātha kimadya tvāṃ paśyāmaḥ kṛpaṇaṃ yathāprāha patnivacaḥ śrutvā jñātvā svā'bhimataṃ śubhamabhavat prakaṭstāsu priyāḥ śṛṇuta me vacaḥviditaṃ te nāradokteḥ sarvaṃ me samabhīpsitamkintu daityeṣu svarūpaṃ nigūhitumiti sthitiḥyadi te niścyo yuddhe hatā yāsyāmaḥ tatsthitamtatte mārgaḥ pravidito vadā'smākaṃ kathaṃ gatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrutvā proktaṃ priyābhistat prāha harṣasunirbharaḥna bhavedanyathā hyetat sarvathā kāranam bruvenūnaṃ sā me'brabīdevaṃ tripurā'smatsamāśrayādiśatyasādhyamapi ca tato naḥ syāt samīhitamtallokaṃ tadbhavedevaṃ sarvathā 'pi na saṃśayaḥgantavyamiti tatrāpi bhavedeva tathā 'pyahamnūnaṃ loke suhṛdbandhuvaidhuryaṃ jātu vai kṣaṇametāvat prārthyate nūnaṃ na bhavet sakṣaṇaḥ kvacitsā sādhayati bhaktānāmasābhyamapi vāñchitamśokaṃ jahatha rāj~yo'tra prāpto'bhudaya ucchritaḥathā'gatā viśukrādyā bhrātaro mantriṇastathāpraṇamyā'surabhūpālaṃ viviśuḥ svasvaviṣtarekṛtā'ñcjaliḥ praṇamyā.'ha vardhayitvā'dbhutaṃ vacaḥnāśitā'khiladaityānāṃ buddhirnītisamānugāviśukraḥ so'pi vimataṃ prāha svārthaviṣaryayambhāvyarthasyā'nurodhena bhuddhimunmeṣayatyalamjīvatsvasmāsu daityeṣu pa"yāmyetadasāmpratamviśukra kiṃ vadāmyadya kālasyaivaṃ viparyayeyasya yuddhe viṣṇumukhā yūyo jātāḥ parāṅmukhāḥso'dyā'hamabalāsaṅghairvyarthayuddhe kadarthitaḥkāle mṛtiḥ ślāghyatamā nedṛśasya kadarthanādaityeśaivaṃ nar'hasi tvaṃ bhāṣituṃ karuṇaṃvacaḥnaisargikaste dharmo'yaṃ strīṣu śastraparāvṛtiḥdaityeṣvavanyatamo'pyekasvayā'jñapto muhūrtataḥtvaṃ tiṣṭhā'ntaḥpure krīḍhan suravāragaṇaiḥ saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityukvā parśvataḥ praikṣat kuṭilākṣaṃ camūpatimyuvarāja kimevaṃ tvaṃ bravīṣi mayi jīvatisenāsenādhipaiḥ sākaṃ gatvā'haṃ sādhayāmi tāmityuktvā praṇipatyaitānniryayau nagarādbahiḥathā'gatya durmadā'khyovāhinīṣo mahābalaḥprāhā'haṅkāraśailasthaḥ praṇamyā'tmacamūpatimavalāvijayenaiva prayāṇaṃ vaḥ susammatammuhūrtamātrādyadi tāṃ nā'neṣyāmi tatastvayāvādayan jaitrayātrā'ṅgavāditrāṇi muhurmuhaḥdaityasenāsamārabhmakolāhalamaharavamgatvā śrīmātaraṃ natvā mantriṇī daṇḍinīmapiyayatuḥ śaktisenābhirasaṅkhyābhiḥ samāyuteraṇakolāhalā'khyānaṃ prāleyā'dririvonnatamtāruṇyāmbhodhilaharī lāvaṇyaughasamudrikādaityāmbudheḥ śoṣaṇāya śarān bhānukaropamānasaṅkhyā vāraṇā'ruḍhā śaktyaścā'pi tādṛśāḥpratyekaṃ tādṛśī śaktirgarjane tryaṅkuśagrahākasmiṃścidekā saṃruḍhā'nekāścā'nyeṣu saṃsthitāḥgrasantīva daityasenāṃ vyāpya bhūmimuṣā'yayaudaityasenāṃ samāseduste yuddheṣvanivartinaḥpravṛttaḥ "śastrapāto'pi prāṇacoramahāravaḥgṛghrakākakaṅkaghūkabhāsakekyadhisaṃśrayāḥcaṇḍaśūlakhaḍgacakrabhindipāladharāḥ pareevaṃvidhairdaityagaṇaiḥ sametā śaktivāhinīparasparaṃ kṣipantaste vākyaiḥ kaṭurasodayaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityādibahuvākyāni vadantyaḥ śaktyo raṇeevaṃ pravṛtte samare prāṇadyute bhayaṅkareevaṃvidhāḥ śaktyo'pi daityahetibhirāhatāḥjaghnuḥ pratyarthināṃ vṛndaṃ śastrairdantaiśca muṣṭibhiḥanye bhagnairathāṅaiśca hetibhiryuyudhurbhṛśambavurnadyo lohitaughāḥ saphenilataraṅgikāḥpalāyitaṃ gādhaviddhaṃ daśā'kṣauhiṇiśeṣitamuṣṭrā'ruḍho gadāhastaḥ kālā'ntakayamopamaḥprāhiṇicchaktisenāsu mahāvegaṃ mahābalamsṛkkiṇīprāntavigalanmāṃsapiṇḍā'bhajihvakaḥphenapiṇḍānudgiraṃśca mūtrayan pṛṣṭhato bahunāśayan daśanaiścaiva vyacaracchaktisainyakeśaktisenā'ntaka iva kadanaṃ prakarodruṣāraṇakolāhalaṃ tasya nāśāya samacodayatayudhyata viṣāṇā'grakumbhā'ghātairmuhurmuhaḥevaṃ yuddhaṃ samabhavattumulaṃ karabhebhayoḥnipātya pādenā'kramyā'karottaṃ karabhaṃ vyasumsaṃbhrāmya pātayanmūrghnaiṃgadāṃ vāraṇakumbhyoḥjānubhyāṃ vikalo bhūmiṃ prāptaḥ śoṇitamudgniranjahau prāṇān durmado'pi dvidhorasi vipāṭitaḥadṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭato yāntiḥ śaktīrjīvitahetavedurmadavadho nāma ṣaṭṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥkruddha ājñāṃ samādāya kuṭilākṣān mahābalaḥvilokya punarāyāntīṃ daityasenāṃ nabhonibhāmturaṅgā vividhāstuṅgāstaraṅgā iva rejire
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: phenapiṇḍanibhānaśvānāruḍhāḥ kanakaprabhāḥaparāḥ kālajīmūtanibhavājisamāśrayāḥdhanurbāṇadharā nīlaratnakoṭīraśobhitāḥkuruvindasamānāṅgyaḥ pāṭalāṃśukabhūṣaṇāḥevaṃ vicitrā'bhrayutasandhyā'kāśanibhā camuḥbherīkāhalagośṛṅgapaṭahā'nakanisvanaḥhuṅkārā'hvānavikṣepā'sphoṭasaṃrāvamāṃsalaḥatha pravṛttaḥ samaraḥ karālo'suvikarṣaṇaḥturaṅgakhuravikṣepavidhūtarajasāṃ gaṇaḥkṣaṇaṃ kuhuniśīthā'bhaṃ jātaṃ hīnā'valokanamrajo'ndhakāraḥ saṃśāntaḥ punarāsīnmahāraṇaḥbalīyasībhirdaityānāṃ śaktibhisteja āhṛtamchinnapādakaraśrotrakukṣipṛṣṭhā mahāsurāḥvadanto hā hatāsmeti tvaktvā yuddhaṃ vidudruvuḥaśvāruḍho mahaścāpaṃ vikarṣan sāyakān kṣipanśaravarṣaiḥ kuraṇḍā'bdanirmuktaiḥ śaktivāhinībhagnāyāṃ śaktisenāyāmaśvāruḍhā samāsadattaptahemanibhāmacchadukūlā'bharaṇojjvalāmduṣṭe'baliptā'si ciraṃ mocayāmyavalepakamtvāṃ nihatya raṇe paścānmukta syāṃ bhrātṛdoṣataḥevaṃ proktā roṣitā'śvāruḍhā tīkṣṇaiḥ śaraistribhiḥdvitīyena ca koṭīraṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtalehatā'śvo bhraṣṭamukuṭo vihato balavaddhṛdikṣaṇena mūrcchānirmuktaḥ prāha tāṃ raṇamūrdhniśrutvetyāha punardevi dhiktvaṃ jīvasi daityaka !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paśyemaṃ taṃ jīvaharaṃ śaraṃ śatrumadā'pahamdevyāścāpaṃ praciccheda śareṇā'nataparvaṇāatha daityo'pi khaḍgena tasyāḥ khaḍgaṃ dvidhā'karotkhaḍgaprahāranirbhinnamastako'śvo hyapa'kramatākṛṣya prāharanmūrghni sṛṇinā dīptatejasāevaṃ kuraṇḍaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā senā'dhipo ruṣākuṭilākṣaḥ prāha senādhīśo'ruṇitalocanaḥyutā gatvā drutaṃ hatvā baddhvā tāṃ vāraṇe drutamsarpiṇyākhyā tayā sarve nanvajeyāḥ surā'suraiḥviṃśatyakṣauhiṇīyutāḥ pratyekaṃ yoddhumāyayuḥvajralomā gṛghrarathe gaje kākamukhastathāyuddhasaṃrambhadaityānāṃ niśamyā'timahādhvanimatha sammukhamāsādya sene te śaktidaityayoḥcakrāte śaravarṣāṇi durānmeghatatī ivakrodhadaṣṭadacchadāḍhyaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanamchidritaṃ śarajālena parighotpātapeṣitamgajavājimahāsenā śaktīnāmatiroṣitādṛṭvā senāṃ hataprāyāṃ karaṅkādyā mahāsurāḥkālyamānāṃ daityavaraiḥ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā parāhatāmtābhyāṃ bhagnā yudhi tadā karaṅkādyā mahāsurāḥbhīmarūpāṃ caṇḍaravāṃ vividhaṃ sarpamaṇḍalamatha sā mukhenetrādisambhūtaiḥ sarpamaṇḍalaiḥtadvaiśasamatīvograṃ dṛṣṭvā kāścana śaktyaḥprāpya tāṃ kolavadanāṃ śrīmātṛsavidhe sthitāmdaṇḍanāthe vayaṃ yātāḥ sampaddevyā sahā'suraiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: durmado nihato yuddhe sampadīśyā kuraṇḍakaḥnāśitā'smābhiratyugrā evaṃ daityā vinirjitāpravartitā mahāmāyā sarpiṇyākhyā hi sāmpratamtaiḥ sarpairnihatā daṣṭā baddhā bhasmīkṛtā parādevyau te śaravarṣeṇa sarpān ghanntyau muhurmuhaḥnivārya tāṃ mantranāthā jñātvā'moghāñca sarpiṇīmatha dhyātvā kṣaṇenā'mbā jṛmbhamāṇā mukhā'mbujamkanakābhā mahāśaktirdevītālusamudbhavātāṃ praṇamya sthitāmagre prāha śrīlaliteśvarīityuktā sā kṣaṇenaiva samprāptā'havamaṇḍalamsarpabandhavinirmuktāḥ śaktyaḥ protthitāstataḥtaddṛṣṭvā sarpanivahavyāptaṃ śaktigaṇaṃ muhaḥnakulāste mahāvegāścitravarṇāḥ suroṣitāḥte sṛṣṭā nakulāḥ śīghraṃ tān sarpān sarvataḥ sthitānnakulastādṛśaiḥ sarpāḥ khaṇḍitā bhakṣitā apiatha te nakulāḥ sarpān vināśyā'pariśeṣataḥsarpiṇyāntu praṇaṣṭāyāṃ karaṅkādyā mahāsurāḥtatasteṣāñca śastrāṇi vāhanānyapi sarvataḥkhaḍgacchinnottamāṅgāste nipeturvigatā'savaḥjayaśabdairvardhyamanānnakulīnakulān hitāmpraṇamya jayavṛttāntamācakhyau vidhṛtā'ñjaliḥnakulīparākrame karaṅkādivadho nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥkuṭilākṣo viniḥśvasya cintāmāpa mahattarāmdurmadaśca kuraṇḍaśca balinau nihatau raṇeete karaṅkapramukhāḥ sarpiṇyāmoghayā yutāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yā śrūyate śaktigaṇanāyikā lalitā'bhidhāaho ! kiṃ na bhavelloke viparīte vidhau nanubalaṃ kṣīṇaṃ caturthāṃ'śaṃsainyeśā balino hatāḥpratijñāya śaktijayaṃ rājñe'haṃ kathamadya vaievaṃ cintāsamākrānte kuṭikākṣe camūpataudṛṣṭvā viṣaṅgaṃ seneśaḥ kuṭikākṣaḥ samutthitaḥatha dṛṣtvā viṣaṇṇā'syaṃ viṣaṅgaḥ sainyanāyakamtayā bhakteṣṭadāyinyā mohito daityapuṅgavaḥtadvadā'śu kiṃ nimittaṃ samaṃ sarva karomyahamaviśāśañca śaktīnāṃ mahābhayamupasthitammohito māyayā devyā babhdāṣe buddhimānivavinā yuktyā na jīyeta mahābalavatā paraḥmayā śaktijayo prāyo niścitaḥ sūkṣmabudhināahaṃ manye hatāḥ śaktigaṇā ityeva yuktitaḥkūṭenaiva vijeyā sā tatkrmaṃ niścitaṃ bruvemahatyā daṃśitāḥ sarve viśukreṇā'pi saṃvṛtāḥgantavyameva yaddhāya yathā śaktigaṇāḥ apitāvadrātrābandhakārairdetyairbahubhirāvṛtaḥtasyā rathaṃ samāruhya tatratyā api kāścanalalitāmabalāṃ duṣṭāṃ śaktisaṅghaśiphātmikāmtasyāṃ hatāyāṃ baddhāyāmapi vā śaktivāhinīmyā tu sā lalitā rājñīsukumārakarāṅghrikāevaṃ mayā vyavasitaṃ buddhyā'tyantapragalmayā"śrutvā viṣaṅgavacanaṃ kuṭilāks'śca bhūpatiḥprahṛṣṭa utthāya ca taṃ taṃ drutaṃ sa pariṣasvaje
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāle jayavahā buddhirdurlabhā sarvathā nanuciraṃ jīva rājakāryasādhakastvaṃ mato mamarājaputrān viśukrañcā'yāhi yudhāya sarvathāvayaṃ yadā śaktisenāṃ niyudhyāmastadā drutamityukte kuṭilākṣe'tha viṣaṅgo nagaraṃ yayaumāyāvimūḍairdaityeśaḥ sammataḥ saṃyayau drutamkuṭilākṣeṇa saṅgamya sarvasenāsamāvṛtaḥviditvā daityarājasya sannāhamatisaṃvṛtammantriṇī lalitādevīṃ natvā vṛttaṃ vyajijñapatvatse bhaṇḍāsurasyā'yaṃ saṃrambho dṛśyate mahānasmābhirapi gantavyaṃ niḥśeṣeṇa drutantu tatityājñaptā kolamukhī sarvaśakticamūvṛtānirgatā śaktisenā sā gajavājirathā'kulāyuddhavāditraninadairgajavājirathasvanaiḥtaṃ bhīmaṃ lokadalanaṃ śrutvā daityā mahāsvanamsa ghoṣaḥ senayormiśro vyarucadrodasīgataḥathā'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ senayoḥ śaktidaityoḥtathā daityān śaktyo'pi mamadrdurhetipātanaiḥdecit kṛpāṇinā madhye pāṭitāḥ śakalīkṛtāḥkeciścakreṇa saṃcchinnakandharodarabāhavaḥamoghapāśaiḥ paritaḥ pāśitāḥ kecidañjasāvikṣatāḥ kecidurasi tomarā'ṅkuśasāraṇaiḥathaśaktigaṇairbhagnā daityasenā pravidrutāanudrutāḥ śaktigaṇaiḥ śaraṇaṃ prepsavo'bhitaḥtaraṅgaiḥ kaṅkālagaṇān vāhayantyaḥ samedhitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ daityapravidrāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaṇḍā'nujastadāprovācā'hūya vijñāya tānameyaparākramānanāthāniva yuddheṣu kālyamānān samantataḥtapasā bhavatāṃ netre sūryaḥ svāṃ'śaṃ dadau kilaityājñapto bhrātṛyuto yayau śaktīrvihiṃsitumsūcīmukhaḥ karālākṣaḥ karaṭaśceti sapta tesa santapto'titarṣeṇa prayāti nidhanaṃ drutamevaṃ vidhāste senāyāṃ praviśya yugapattadāatha tāḥ śaktyaḥ sarvā daityānāmavalokanātevamatyantasantāpatṛṣābhyāṃ samabhiplutammantriṇīṃ daṇḍinīṃ tyaktvā sarvaṃ śaktigaṇaṃ yadātannetravīryaṃ na tayoḥ pravṛttaṃ tanmahitvataḥvicārya mantriṇī cā'pi viditvā ravyanugrahamsasmāra manasā śaktiṃ tiraskaraṇikā'bhidhāmsamāruḍhā nīlavapurnīlāṃśukavibhūṣaṇāsvasamākāraśaktīnāṃ koṭibhiḥ parivāritāāgatya mantriṇīṃ natvā prāha kiṃ saṃsmṛteti vaivisarjayāmāsa punaḥ śaktīnāṃ śāntihetaveājñaptaivaṃ samāruhyā'dṛśyavāhanamuttamamnāśayāmāsa daityānāṃ senāṃ śastranipātanaiḥandhībhūtāḥ kiñcidapi dadṛśurno kathañcanaciraṃ yuddhairvinirjitya tiraskaraṇikā tataḥhate balāhakamukhe tiraskaraṇikāṃ surāḥjahṛṣurdevatāmukhyā lokakaṇṭakanāśanātevaṃ tiraskṛtirjitvā daityāṃstapanalocanān

sanskrit: āliṅgya te kṛtaṃ kṛtyamasādhyaṃ sarvathā tvayāevaṃ balāhakamukhe hate sūryo'stamāyayautiraskaraṇikāyuddhe balāhakādivadho nāmā'ṣṭaṣaṣtitamo'dhyāyaḥtripurāmāyayā muḍhāḥ saṅkalpajayaharṣitāḥpārṣṇigrahavidhānāya preṣayitvā vidhāntaḥviśukro mantriṇīṃ daṇḍarājñīṃ senāpatiḥ svayamulūkajitprabhṛtayo gajavājivahe tathāastaṃ yāte savitarī sarvatastamasā'vṛtemuhūrtamātraṃ (tat?) sandhyāprakāśairabhavadraṇaḥabhavaddāruṇaṃ yuddaṃ śaktidānavasenayoḥyuyudhuḥ śastrajālaiste śaktibhirdaityapuṅgavāḥācchādayannabhobhāgaṃ tārakāgaṇasaṃvṛtamyuyudhuḥ śaktidaityāṇāṃ gaṇāścā'krmayogataḥśastraṇyanyeṣu yuñjanti tānyanyān ghātayanti hitatra daityairhatā daityāḥ śaktibhiḥ śaktyastathākecchistrairvinihatāḥ pare rathavigharṣitāevaṃ mahattare tatra sammrdda sati vaiśaseantaṃ madhyamathā'diṃ vā senāyāḥ ke'pi no viduḥjvālāmukhīṃ mahādevīṃ sasmāra tripurāṃśajāmjvalatparvatasaṅkāśā jvālāvyāptadigantarātadā daityāḥ śaktyo'pi yuyudhuḥ kramasaṅgatāḥbālā bhaṇḍasutairyuddhaṃ vicitramatanodbhṛśamtriṃśatsaṃkhyā ekakālaṃ yuyudhurbālayā dṛḍhambālāṃ samācchaduḥ śastrairdineśaṃ stuhinairivanāśayāmāsa vegena tamaḥ sūryodayo yathā

sanskrit: pratyekaṃ bhaṇḍatanujarathāśvānakaronmṛtāntathaikena punasteṣāṃ hṛdi vivyādh līlayāmṛtaprāyāḥ samabhāvan vyathayā gāḍhamūrcchitāḥte ṣaṣtisaṅkhyā yuddheṣu bhīmavīryāḥ suyodhinaḥvicitrayuddhaṃ tanvāte draṣṭṛvismāpanaṃ paramyuddhdhvā ciraṃ hayāruḍhā baddhvā pāśena tān kramātsampannāthā'pi tairyuddhvā bhūyo bhallena tān kramātugrakarmaprabhṛtayo yuyudhustatra saṃyugeyuddhvaivaṃ mantribhiḥ sā'pi kruddhā khaḍgena pātayatparasparaprayuktāni nānāśastrāṇi cichiduḥprasahya kolavadanāṃ yuyodhā'tisuśikṣitaḥniṣprāṇānakarodaṣṭau karṇā'kṛṣṭairghanuścyutaiḥśareṇorasi saṃviddha īṣat niṣprajñatāṃ gataḥkiricakrarathā'baddhasiṃhamūrghni prapātayattathā jagarja kariṇaṃ hatveva harilocanaḥpunaḥ prajñāṃ prāpya ruṣā dṛṣṭvā daityaṃ puraḥ sthitampātitoraḥsthalo raktadhārāṃ muñcadanekadhāparivāraśaktigaṇaḥ kadanaṃ kalyayadruṣāvārāhyā vṛttimukhyā yā jambhinī śaktiruttamāyudhyamānaṃ śareṇā'sye nijaghāna mahābalāpunarutplutya gadayā tāṃ mūghni prāharadruṣāevaṃvidhāṃ śaktigaṇā dṛṣṭvā hā heti cukruśuḥutthitā jambhinī bhūyo dṛṣṭvā bhagnaṃ nijaṃ dhanuḥathā'bhavadgadāyuddhaṃ bhīmaṃ tvāṣṭrendrasannibhammatvā rathaṃ saṅkucitaṃ bhūmau tābhyām bhūt kṛtam

sanskrit: vicitrā'kramaṇotplāvacitrasaṃsthānasundaramyāvattāvattayā murghni balavadgadayā hataḥvarṣastāṃ patito bhūmau śīrṇasarvā'ṅgabandhanaḥhataṃ vīkṣya camūnāthaṃ daityā bhītāḥ palāyitāḥevaṃ daityaṃ nihatyā'śu jambhini daṇḍanāyikāmdadau parīrambhaṃ premṇā tāṃ prasamīkṣataviśukro'pi mahāśūro yuvarājo'tivīryavānparasparasya śastrāṇi pratiśastrairvināśayanevaṃ ciraṃ niyudhyantamatyadbhūtaparākramamyugapaccharasaṅghena rathamaśvāṃśca sārathimevaṃ yuddhe parībhūto viśukro manyunā jvalanathā'yāntaṃ khaṅgakaraṃ dūrādekena patriṇāchinnakheṭakanistriṃśamāyāntaṃ baddhamuṣṭikambhallāhato viśukro'pi saphenaṃ rudhiraṃ vamanavaśaḥ saṃvartakena vāyuneva mahāgiriḥevaṃ viśukre'bhihate daityasenā hyabhidrutāviśukraṃ mūrcchitaṃ daityāḥ samādāya puraṃ yayuḥviditvā lalitāṃ cakrarathasthāmekalāṃ tadājetuṃ śakyeti saṃhṛṣṭo yayau tatrā'suro drutamalpasenāparīvāraḥ śastrāstrabahusaṅkulaḥgajāruḍhairyuto mattagajamāruhya saṃyayausametya saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā pṛthaṅnāgaiśca saṇghaśaḥtataḥ kecichaktisenāṃ vāmato'nye ca dakṣataḥevaṃ pṛthak saṅghaśaste yayurdasyuryathā tataḥmilitāste sarva eva tato nimiṣamātrataḥ

sanskrit: kiṃ dayā te sumahatī jātaḥ kasmānnirāyudhaḥupalabdhaṃ śastraṃ vyarthaṃ vijayahetaveśrutvā kāmeśvarīvākyaṃ kaṭukaṃ sopahāsakamtadā tribhiḥ śariarbhūyo vivyādhā'tibalena tampadānna calituṃ draṣṭuṃ muṣṭiñca vinivartitumtāvat kāmeśvarī devī śarajālaiśca sarvataḥruddho'tha sarvato mārge māyāṃ daityo vitānayatvṛṣṭiñcakre mahabhūtān rākṣasapretasaṅghakānsṛṣṭāṃ sṛṣṭāñca tāṃ māyāṃ daityasyāstrairapā'karotsahasravaktro niyutahastapādo'tivegavāndṛṣṭvā bhītaṃ śaktigaṇaṃ taṃ yojanamitonnatamtenā'streṇa kṣaṇādeva māyāḥ sarvā vyanīnaśatbaddhavā nipātayāmasa svapuraḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥlajjito namravadano mṛtavanmīlitekṣaṇaḥānayadhvaṃ śaktigaṇā nityāsā (pyavadattadā) hi sā (?)gatvā rathaṃsamāruhya praṇemurlalitā'mbikāmsamājagmurvijityā'rīnnatvā procurjayaṃ raṇevismitāstatra surāścā'pi daityānāṃ śaṭhatāṃ pratiniśāmya śaktyaḥ procuratikrodhatayā'kulāḥśrutvā daṇḍā'dhisammrājñī vadhaṃ tasya vyacintayatvadho na yukto baddhasya mṛtatulyo hi sa smṛtaḥityuktvā mocayāmāsa prāha taṃ mantriṇī tadāśrutvaivaṃ mantriṇīvākyaṃ lajjito daityapuṅgavaḥatha tatra śaktigaṇaṃ sametaṃ lalitā'mbayārātriralpāvaśeṣā'sti punaḥ sūryodayaṃ prati

sanskrit: tadasmābhiḥ punaryuddhe gantavyaṃ sarvasenayāyadypi śrīmahādevyā mahimno nā'sti durghaṭamvimṛśya mantraṃ buddhyaitadyuktaṃ jñātvā samīkuruamaṃsatā'tha tadyuktaṃvicāryaśuddhayā dhiyāvadatyeṣā varāhā'syā sūrasyodayanaṃ pratiakośe senayā hīne ratha eṣa tavā'śrayaḥniyuddhaśrāntimabhyetya rātrau viśrāntimeṣyatina svasthahṛdayā bhūyo viśrāmaṃ nopayanti vaipraviṭtiṃ bhāvayiṣyāmi śatrūṇāmapradharṣiṇīmatha sā tithirnityāsu yā tatrā'sti caturdaśīājñāmātreṇa sā devī jvālāmālinikā'bhidhāvalayīkṛtya śaktīnāṃ senāṃ sālaḥ samāsthitaḥantaḥ śītalayan śaktīrbahiryojanadūragamathaivaṃ sālamālokya śaktyo gatasābhvasāḥsahasrasaṅkhyā rakṣartha mantranāthā samādiśatevaṃ jvālāsālamadhye sthitā śrīlalitāmbikāviṣaṅgaparājayavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥdukṣito'titarāṃ dīno hatotsaho'tiniḥsvasantatra śuśrāva seneśaṃ kuṭilākṣañca mantriṇḥtāvadviśukro'bhiyayau rājaputrasamāvṛtaḥpapraccha vatsa kiṃ te'dya paśyāmi malinaṃ mukhamśrutvaivaṃ bhrātṛvacanaṃ niḥśvasan prāha sa'nujaḥjānāmi daityanāśāya kāla eṣo'pradakṣiṇaḥparābhavo'balāsaṅghairmṛgeśasyaivajambukaiḥtat kiṃ karomi nāsīnme mṛtyuryuddheṣu sarvathā

sanskrit: nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥlīlāṃ vitanvatī śīghraṃ saṃsmitapremabhāvataḥkaṭākṣān kāmeśamukhasaundaryābdhāvamūrcchayatgaṇanāthaḥ samudabhūdibhāsyo'ruṇasamprabhaḥmātuluṅgaṃ dhanuścakraṃ pāśaṃ dhānyasya mañjarīmraktakauśeyavasano divyāmālyavibhūṣaṇaḥśaktyā samāśliṣṭadeho galanmadajalā'ilaḥdevī brūhi mayā yattatkṛtyamatra raṇodyameśrutvaivaṃ prāha gaṇapaṃ lalitāmbā maheśvarīevaṃ tayā samājñapto gaṇeśo dhūnayan karamāsādya vighnayantraṃ tacchaktisaṅghasya paśyataḥnimiṣāttaccūrṇayitvā tilaśastadanantaramniviśya daityasenāṃ tāṃ yuyudhe daityapuṅgavaiḥśūlena dārayaścānyān śarairanyān vibheda caevaṃ daityapatīn bhūyo gaṇeśaḥ kṣayamānayatnāsāvāyumahāvegavikṛṣṭāḥ saṅgha"śo'surāḥśuṇḍā'ntarbhāgasaṅghaṭṭānmṛtāśchinnā'ṅgabandhanāḥprāṇān jahustathā'nye cā'kṣatāḥ śrotravilāyanātevaṃ vināśayan daityāṃstatsenāyāṃ gaṇeśvaraḥviṣaṅgaṃ hṛdi dantena cakarā'tyantavikṣatamtadā dṛṣṭvā daityagaṇā matvā pratyakṣamantakamdṛṣṭvaivaṃ vidrutaṃ sainyaṃ viśukro'tiruṣānvitaḥathā'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ viśukragajavaktrayoḥathebhavaktraḥ saṅkruddho gadāpātena tadrathamatha kruddho viśukro'pi gadāmudyamya vegataḥ

sanskrit: gadāprahārasambhinnakumbhadeśādgaṇeśituḥjaghāna śūlena hṛdi viśukrasyā'tivegataḥevaṃ viśukraṃ nirjitya yayau bhaṇḍarathaṃ prativicārayat svāntaraṅge tamajeyaṃ vibhāvayanajeyo'yaṃ mahāvīryaḥ sarvairdevāsurairapiśarstrahata imaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā tallokamāpnuyāmnūnameṣa purā yuddhaṃ cakre yena mahaujasātato'haṃ tāṃ samāyāsye yoddhaṃ śrīlalitāmbikāmparvatā'bhaṃ mahābhīmaṃ parighodyatsupuṣkaramāsādya gajadaityaṃ taṃ yuyodha gaṇanāyakaḥśaktyaḥ prakṛtiṃ prāpya niryuryuddhagetaveaśeṣadaityasenānāṃ mantriṇī daṇḍinīyutāaśeṣaśaktisenābhirdaśitābhiḥ parivṛtāsamāruhyebhasenābhirnirjagāmā'tisambhramātaśvāruḍhā'śvasenābhirāvṛtā yuddhasambhramātbālā praṇamya lalitāṃ prāha mañjulayā girāsadā yuddhavidhānāya samutsukitamānasāmpādau mūrdhnā spṛśāmyeṣā dehyajñāṃ samarāya meādye dine'pi me yuddhaṃ nā'sīnmānasapūraṇamadya me pūrayasvā'śāṃ cirādyuddhāya sambhṛtāmprahasantī mantranāthāmukhaṃ samavalokayatkumāri ! śṛṇu me vākyaṃ yadi tvaṃ yoddhumicchasiekena saha yudhyasva daṇḍinyā ca mayā sahapraveṣṭavyaṃ kvacidvā'pi tavā'vāṃ pakṣasaṃśrayeśrutvaivaṃ mantriṇīvākyaṃ prāha bālā'mbikā punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvathā bāṇamekaṃ vā visṛjedahamekalaāyudhādini nāśyāni anyābhirjātu kutracitekena yudhyasva raṇe devyādiṣṭe kathaṃ tvayābhaṇḍaputra mahāśurā bhaṇḍatulyaparākramāḥekena teṣu yudhyasva yena yoddhuṃ samīpsitampraṇamya bhūyastairyuddhamayācata kṛtā'ñjaliḥdadāvanujñāṃ samare āśliṣya prītipūrvakammātaranyacchṛṇu vaco daṇḍinyesā mayā sahavyanāśayadyuddharasaṃ yadyāgacchenmayā sahayadi yuddhe punarvighnaṃ kariṣyati tadā śṛṇuevaṃ vadantīṃ bālāṃ tāṃ matvā ruṣṭāñca otriṇīdevi śaṅkāṃtyaja mayi āgacchāmi tvayā sahatavā'jñāmanurudhyaiva purataḥ pṛṣṭo'pi vāiti śrutvā daṇḍinīṃ sā modādāśliṣya satvarammantriṇī daṇḍanāthā ca svasvasyandanasaṃsthiteatha śrīcakrarājākhyarathamāruhya sattavaramtatpṛṣṭhataḥ samāruhya timirastomasamprabhamvikarṣantī śaktisenāmameyāṃ sāgaropamāmyudhavādyacitraravo nemighoṣā'timāṃsalaḥhayahveṣitasaṃrāvaivṛrvadhe'titarāṃ tadālohitānāṃ mahā'sāravarṣaṇo'tibhayaṅkaraḥdrutaṃ vīryaṃ darśya te pa"ya me'dya parākramamśithilāṅgāḥ śaraiḥ kecit kecit paraśudāritāḥniṣpiṣṭāḥ parighairanye cakraiśchinnagalāḥ parebhindipālaiḥ śakalitā gadābhirbhinnamastakāḥ

sanskrit: saritaḥ śoṇitavahā vavustatra sahasraśaḥpalāyitā krandamānā śaktiśastrā'tivedhitājalāśayācchinnabandhāttoyānīva kṣayaṃ gatācaturbāhumukhāstriṃśatsaṅkhyāścitraparākramāḥrathā'ruḍhā śaktisenāṃ jaghnuḥ sāyakavṛṣṭibhiḥśastrā'stratejo daityānāmasahyaṃ prāpya sarvataḥsarvasenāsamāgamavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥhayā'nana ! mahāścaryamākhyānaṃ samyagīritamyuddhaṃ tayoḥ kathamabhūttanmamā'cakṣva pṛcchataḥgaṇanāthamahāyuddhāṃ pravaktumupacakramegaṇanāthamahāvīryasambhṛtāṃ saṃyutāṃ rasaiḥmuhūrtamātramabhavattayoryuddhaṃ suduḥsahamtulyarūpāṃstulyajavāṃstulyasāhasavikramānsasarja svātmanastulyān gaṇeśānapi koṭiśaḥyuyudhuścitraśastrastraistadadbhutamivā'bhavatdadṛśuḥ prekṣakā bhūtvā yuddhasaṃrambhavismṛteḥkaścicchūlāhataḥ kaściścakreṇa śakalīkṛtaḥkaścinnighṛṣṭa urasā kaścitpādaprapeṣitaḥevaṃ te nāśitā daityā daityasṛṣṭā gajānanaiḥyuyodha balavāṃstatra gaṇeśenā'tisāhasīsañjhāra gaṇapatīn svāṅge nimiṣamātrataḥanekaśastrā'stragaṇaiḥ saṅkulaṃ subhayaṅkaramsahastrā'syastaddviguṇabhujaścitrā'yudhairvṛtaḥsṛṣṭaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ śastragaṇaṃ nāśayad gaṇanāyakaḥciccheda yugapattasya dhṛtaṃ śastrasahasrakam
