sanskrit: mahatyā gadayā nūnaṃ nighnatoritaretaramśakalībhūya patitā tato daityo nirāyudhaḥgadāpratihatā'ṅgena papāta bhuvi sā vṛthākṣiptaṃ kṣiptaṃ vṛthā bhūmāvapataddehasaṅgataḥdṛṣṭvā daityaṃ sarvaśastrairajeyaṃ sa gaṇādhipaḥathā'bhavattayormuṣṭiyuddhamatyantadāruṇamtaṃ tato bāhubandhena baddhā daityaṃ nipātayatevaṃ vidārito daityo jahau prāṇāṃstadā raṇeyudhāyā'bhyājagāmā'śu gaṇeśo'dbhutavikramaḥcintayalllitāṃ devīṃ bhītastasya parākramātiti pūraya madvāñchāṃ prapannastvatpadā'mbujamsasmāra sindhuramukhaṃ cakrarājarathasthitāpraṇamya prāha mātaḥ kiṃ smṛto yuddhavidhau sthitaḥvatsā'laṃ yuddhavidhinā tiṣṭha matpārśvato'dhunāityājñapto gaṇeśāno virarāma niyuddhataḥtān sayakaiḥ kirantī sā bālā yuddhe samāsadatatyadbhutakriyāṃ yuddhe bālāṃ vavrūraṇā'jirebālāṃ rathasthāṃ vavṛṣurgarjanto yudhdhadurmadāḥśṛṇudhvaṃ śaktyaḥ sarvā bālāmbājñāṃ bravīmi vaḥprayoktavyaṃ śastragaṇaṃ daṇḍyā sā me'nyathā bhavetiti saṅghoṣya senāsu mantriṇyā sahitā svayamatha śrutvā daṇḍarājñyāḥ śāsanaṃ muditā hi sāsiddharṣidevatāmukhyāḥ paśyantyā'kāśamāśritāḥatha daityotsṛṣṭaśastravṛndairācchāditā'bhavatdṛṣṭvā channāṃ śastragaṇairvimatāḥ śaktyo'bhavat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vināśya tāṃ śastravṛṣiṃ bhūyaḥ sarvān jaghāna haāyudhāni vāhanāni nāśayiścitravikramāatha tīkṣaṇaiḥ śarairdaityānnāśayat sā'tivegataḥna lakṣyate'tinipuṇadṛśā kenā'pi sarvathāprasaranti śarāstīkṣṇā dikṣvantaravihīnataḥphalānīva supakvān."caṭamāaravāḥnirantaratayā viddhāḥ sahasrākṣa ivā'bhavankecidvakṣasi saṃviddhā hṛtaprāṇāḥ sthiraṃ sthitāḥkeciccharā'hatervegānnīyante gatajīvanāḥevaṃ tayā muhūrtena koṭiśo daityapuṅgavāḥna tatra daityaḥ śūro'pi kaścit svātmā'vane vibhuḥna daityā yuddhamatyantamekākinya viduḥ kvacitśaktisenā nabhaḥsaṃsthā devādyāśca samantataḥathaivaṃ nighnatīṃ bālāṃ dṛṣṭvā daityāścamūṅgatāḥhā hatāḥsmo na ceyaṃ vai yoṣidbālā kumārikāadya niḥśeṣitaṃ sainyaṃ daityānāṃ bhavati kṣaṇātśastradhārāsunicite mārgamaprāpya nirgamekecchiraiḥ susaṃviddhāḥ patitāḥ "śavarāśiṣuevaṃ tadā daityasainyaṃ prāyo naṣṭaṃ palāyitamrathāḥ siṃvāhā mahācāpadharā bhṛśammahāmeghā iva śyāmā garjantī mṛgarājavattairanekaiḥ kumārī sā viṣṇutulyaparākramaiḥmantriṇīdaṇḍinīmukhyā dṛṣṭvā bālāparākramamdevi nūnaṃ sā kumārī na śeṣayitumarhatilīlayaivā'dya niḥśeṣaṃ kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣāṃ vāhān dhvajaṃ chatraṃ yugapannāśayaccharaiḥśarāsanaṃ kramātteṣāṃ ciccheda supatatribhiḥparāmṛśurnihantuṃ tāṃ yāvattavadiyaṃ drutamevaṃ nirāyudhā daityā jātāstasyāḥ parākramamevaṃ bālamahākālagrastān yudhi niśāmya vairakṣituṃ tān rājaputrānabhyāyayaturāśu vaidadṛśe śakhavarṣāṇi kurvantau kālameghavatnivārayallīlayaiva tatastāṃ daityavāhinīmnāmaśeṣāṃ kṛtavatī tatastāvatiroṣitaudṛṣṭvā śarairvāhanebhān yuddhe'nāśayadañjasāmūrcchitau petaturbhūmau vajrā'hatanagāvivatānivṛttān samālokya virathānakarot kṣaṇātprāhare bhaṇḍadāyādāḥ śūrāṇāṃ vaḥ kathaṃ tvidamśutvā kaṭurasodarkaṃ bhāṣitaṃ te'timāninaḥdhiṅmugdhe bālikāṃ dṛṣṭvā dayamānasvabhāvataḥtat paśya sadyastvāṃ kurmo vimadāṃ tat stharībhavapratyekaṃ niśitairbhallaistacchirāṃsi cakartahahāhākāraḥ samudabhūd daityānāṃ vāhinīmukhejayaśabdo mahānāsīcchaktisenāsu sarvataḥbhaṇḍaputravadhakaraṇavarṇanaṃ trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥbālāṃ bhūyaḥ samālakṣya mantriṇīdaṇḍanāyikeanujñātā punaryuddhaṃ yāsyāmaḥ kartumañjasātvamasādhyaṃ kṛtavatī naitadasmacchakaṃ kvacitāruhya cakrarājākhyarathaṃ natvā parāmbikāmvijayañca tataḥ śrutvā tuṣṭā śrīlalitāmbikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhaṇḍaputrān hatān dṛṣṭvā hā hetyuccairvicukruśuḥputranāśaṃ niśamyā'tha bhaṇḍadaityo'tiduḥkhitaḥaho me vipulo mohaḥ smṛtibhraṃśaḥ samudgataḥyathā prārthitaṃ me tattathaiva kṛtaṃ tathāyāntu pañcatvamatha vai tayā devyā raṇe hatāḥiti me prāgvyavasitaṃ prārthitā ca parāmbikācakre tatra mahāmoho vṛthā kiṃ māmupāgataḥtanme'vaśeṣitaṃ kāmaṃ pūryā'śu maheśvari !māṃ sayoṣidgaṇaṃ śīghraṃ yuddhe śastrāgnipāvitamkadā'haṃ candracūḍālaṃ netratrayasuśobhanampaśyan śrīmātṛvadanaṃ dagdhastatsāyakā'gnināprārthayanniti tadrūpaṃ koṭikandarpasundaramtāvattatrā'jagmatustau daityarājasya brātarauamaṃsatuḥ putraśokabharākrāntaṃ sumūrcchitamtayoḥ śamaparaiḥ śabdairdhyeyānnirgatamānasaḥsvarūpagopanārthaṃ sa brātroḥ sammukhataḥ sthitaḥhā putrā māṃ parityajya pitaraṃ duḥkhasāgaremātaro vo'tivātsalyakātarā īdṛśīṃ daśāmityādi vilapantaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tau bhrātarau tadāalaṃ daityeśa ! śokena dhairyavīryā'pahāriṇājvaro nau dehaṃ karīṣamiva pāvakaḥgatvā'vāmekapātena tāṃ hatvā niśitaiḥ śariḥjīvantīṃ vā mṛtāṃ vā.pi vaddhvā neṣyāva āśu vaiyuddhārthamabhyāyayaturativīryaparākramaupṛthak śaktimahāsenāpārśvabhāge prapetatuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śatā'kṣauhiṇīsenābhirviṣaṅgaḥ prāpatadbalītṛtīye yuddhadivase prātaḥ sūryodayaṃ pratitadābhavanmahāśabdaḥ śaktisenāsu pārśvayoḥabhūtāṃ śaṅkite'tyantamūcatuḥ śrīparāmbikāmśruyate bhairavataro daityāḥ kapa'yodhinaḥtadyāva āvāmanujānīhi śīghraṃ maheśvaricelatuḥ samarāyā'śu pṛthak śaktigaṇāvṛteniryayau śrīcakrarājarathadakṣiṇadrārataḥmahāsiṃhayugaṃ pārśve sairibhāggraṃ tathā puraḥtatparśve siṃhasaṃvāharathāruḍhe vicelatuḥbaṭukaiḥ kālikāvṛndairvarāhamukhaśaktibhiḥevaṃ cakrarathadvārāduttarasmāśca mantriṇīsaptaparvayute vedaharidaśvapracāliteśukādyā sārikādyā ca śyāmalā dakṣapārśvagālaghu"yāmalikā pṛṭhe caivametā rathā'śrayāḥmantriṇyaṅgasasudbhūtāḥ śyāmalāḥ koṭikoṭiśaḥsarvāḥ ṣoḍaśavārṣikyastāruṇyaśrīniṣevitāḥkaṭākṣamandahāsābhyāṃ mohayantyo'khilaṃ jagatkāvyā'lāparasā'bhijñā gītavādyavinoditāḥmantranāthā vāhinī sā suśubhe'titarāṃ tadāathā'bhavacchaktisenādaityasenāsamāgamaḥatha dhvanadyuddhavadyahuṅkārā'sphoṭani'svanaḥsenayorubhayostatra badhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥdaityasenāmukhataṭaṃ vidīrṇaṃ śatadhā'bhavatdaityasenāhṛdaṃ śaktisenāstrotaḥ samantataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: "śastrā'gnibhirdaityasenāvanaṃ cakrurhi bhasmasātanye kṛpāṇinā cchinnanikhilāṅgā gatā'savaḥitare śūlasūtreṣu protā maṇigaṇā ivaevaṃ vināśyamānāyāṃ senāyāṃ śaktisenayārathenā'bhyaderavacchaktivāhinīṃ śastravarṣaṇaiḥśaktisenā'pi yuyudhe viśukre ca balīyasījīmūtakāyo devāriḥ karambhaḥ śikhibhāṣaṇaviśukrātmajasaṅkhinnāṃ niśāmya śaktivāhinīmviśukraputrānāsedurvarpantya iṣusantatimciraṃ yuddhvā śaraistatra rathaṃ sūtaṃ śarāsanamjaghāna tīkṣṇadhāreṇa khaḍgena rathavāhanamtāvacchukaśyāmalikā ardhacandreṇuṇā javātdevāriṇā śārikākhyā saṅgatā yuddhakarmaṇisvakīyagadayā'plutya jaghānā'suramastakesaṅgītaśyāmalā yuddhaṃ karambheṇa cakāra hasāhitya"yāmalā yudhdhvā balinaṃ śikhibhāṣaṇamtriśūlaṃ tena dalitahṛdayaḥ prāpa tadvyasuḥchannarūpaḥ "yāmalāya rathapārṣṇiṃ samāsadatdṛṣṭvā laghuśyāmalākhyā sannidhānaṃ samāgatamjaghāna mūrghni tarasā khaḍgenā'tibalīyasāviśukro bhraṣṭamukuṭaḥ krodhāruṇitalocanaḥtāvacchareṇa daityasya gadāṃ ciccheda saptadhātasyā jaghāna tāvat sā prāharanmūrghni sāyakaiḥīśatprajñastāvadenaṃ grahītauṃ laghuśyāmalāpratibuddhastāvadasau matvā svasya hi bandhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāvaj jñātvā rathasthānāḥ śaktyo ripumantiketāvanmatvā śaktigaṇaṃ dusahaṃ daityaśekharaḥtatra dṛṣṭvā mrṭān putrān śokasaṃvignamānasaḥprajvalan śaktisenāṃ tāṃ vidhamaccharavarṣaṇaiḥmantriṇī sāyakā'sārairdhanurjīmūtani'sṛtaiḥtīkṣṇasāyakadhārābhirviśukro'tyantavikṣataḥnīlādrirvṛṣṭidhārābhirgairikārasavatkṣṇamvicitraśastraśalabhairācchādayata mantriṇīmtamālamañjarīvā'timakarandasubṛṃhitāākārṇapūrṇabhallena dhanurjyāmācchinaddrutamtāvattikṣṇapṛṣatkena muṣṭideśe jaghāna tampatitaṃ dhanurādātuṃ yāvannamro mahāsuraḥsa tāvadiṣuṇā bhinnamūrdhā gāḍhasumūrcchayāatha kṣaṇena mantriṇyā nāśitaṃ daityavāhanamtāvanmūrcchāvinirmukto dadarśā'havasādhanamśīrṇa rathāṅgamādāya nihantumupasaṃyayauśareṇā'bhihatāddhastādrathaṅgaṃ prāpatat kṣitaumantriṇīhastagaṃ cāpraṃ bhaṅktuṃ yāvat samācchinatdṛṣṭvā viśukraṃ nihataṃ vidrutā daityavāhinījayaśabdaṃ śaktigaṇāścakrurdevamukhā apiviśukravadhavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥtadā daityaśakticamborabhavadbhairavo raṇaḥbaṭukānāṃ triśulādyardetyā bhūyo'bhivikṣatāḥdṛṣtvā daityacamūṃ śaktigaṇaiḥ prāyo vināśitāmviṣaṅgaputrāḥ proddaṇḍavikramā vīryavattarā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: indraśatruḥ surā'rātirmahākukṣirmadoddhataḥtairhanyamānāṃ tāṃ śaktivāhinīmabhivīkṣya tuandhinī mohinī caiva bhairavaḥ kālakarṣiṇīkarālavaktriṇa yudhi jambhinī saṅgatā'bhavatgadayā'bhijadhānā'śu varāhaṃ śaktivāhanamīṣat papāta purato jānubhyāmavaniṅgataḥviśikhaḥ stambhanīṃ prāpya yuyodhā'tibalī dṛḍhamjaghāna tairmūghni lagnairviśikho'tivyarājataso'pi kruddho'tivegena tīkṣṇadhāreṇa karṇinātāvatkruddhā stambhinī ca gārdhrpatreṇ tejināatha tasya kṣaṇenaiva niśitairvisikhaistribhiḥsa chinnadhanvā'tiruṣā triśūlamatibhāsvaramchittvā triśūlaṃ bhallena śiro daityasya pātayataśastrairastraranekaiśca kṛtapratikṛtairaramcirāṃ yuddhvā tena tatra karṇāntā'kṛṣṭapatriṇāpapāta mūrcchito gāḍhaṃ chinnapakṣa ivā'drirāṭdvāśabdaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā samunnamya ca bāladhimkāścitpratyakpādaghātairdaśanaiścā'vadhūnanaiḥevaṃ śaktīrvinighnantaṃ kharaṃ dṛṣṭvā'ndhinī tadāsa vidvastīkṣṇabāṇena mūrcchitaḥ prapatadbhuvivegena gadayā tasyā vāhanaṃ tāḍayadbalīparato yojanādbhūmau papāta suvimūrcchitaḥmuñcan suśīghraṃ kvāśabdaṃ saghargharamahāravampāścātyapādaghātena santāḍya balavattaramśṛṅgābhyāṃ dārayat kukṣiṃ bhūmāvāsphālya vegataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vimūrcchastāvadabhyetya vibhāṇḍo'bhihanat padāapāharadatikrodhāt kṛttamūrddhāmamāra saḥmohinī garuḍāruḍhā gṛghrastho vikaṭekṣaṇaḥsapakṣayoḥ parvatayorivā'tyantavicitritamnakhaistuṇḍairdāritāṇgo mamāra patito'vanaumohinīcakrasamcchinnagalo mṛtyumupāgataḥsvavāhenā'tibhīmena yuyodhā'tyantasāhasīkoṭisaṅkhyāgaṇayutairaṣṭabhiḥ sevito'niśamkālameghanibhāḥ sarpabhūṣaṇāḥ kṛttivāsasaḥniviśya te nimeṣeṇa niḥśeṣāñcakrurojasākecinnakhaiḥ pāṭitāṇgāḥ kecinmuṣṭibhirāhatāḥevaṃ dṛṣṭvā pranaṣṭāṃ svāmindraśatruścamūṃ ruṣāevaṃ gaṇānardyamānān vīkṣya daityena saṃyugeindraśatruṃ parvatābhaṃ yuyudhuḥ sarpavāhanamvajrasaṃhanaṃ tasya śūladaṇḍaprapātanaiḥtaṃ dṛṣṭvā virujaṃ daityaṃ bhairavāṇāṃ bhayaṅkaramyuddhvā ciramutpatantaṃ gadayā hantumambaramyuddhvā surā'rātirapi kālakarṣṇikā'hvyāmtacchaktigaṇaniḥśeṣīkṛtadaityamahāgaṇaḥsvapneśyā yuyudhe daityo mahākukṣirvṛkāśrayaḥciraṃ yodhayatastasya mahākukṣerbalīyasaḥmadoddhato'pi baṭukabhairave' susaṅgataḥmahākapāladaṇdāḍhyaiḥ sarpabhūṣaṇasaṃyutaiḥtamastomanibhaiścandracūḍairyuktena sarvataḥbaṭukānāṃ gaṇāḥ kruddhā niviśyā'suravāhinīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atha kruddhaṃ daityapatiṃ nipatantaṃ gadādharamdaṇḍā'hatyā dalanmūrdhā vaman raktaṃ saphenilamevaṃ viṣaṅgaḥ putreṣu naṣṭeṣvatyantaduḥkhitaḥnipapātaikapātena pralayā'nilavajjavātśastradhārāṃ vimuñcan vai kurvan satimirā diśaḥatha jambhinimukhyābhirnāśitā kṣaṇamātrataḥkecittriśūlasphuṭitahṛdayā jīvitaṃ jahuḥapare sāyakaiśchannā tato'nye muṣṭidāritāḥkecicchastraughasampātaśakalīkṛtadehakāḥnihatya gadyā śaktisenāṃ bhittvā hyaśeṣataḥgadayaiva hi santāḍay ratharājaṃ samāruhatśaktisenāsu samabhūddhāhā'kāramahādhvanīḥcaturthaparvā'ntarālaṃ prāviśat satvaraṃ balīavaruhya yuyodhoścairmusalena svaparvataḥśastrairvicitrairastraiśca sarvalokabhayaṅkarammāyāṃ prāduścākāroccaiḥ sarvalokabhayāvahamagnivarṣaṃ raktā'medhyādivarṣaṇamsahasrapādabāhvāsyamātmānaṃ śatadhā'pi cabhītāḥ śaktiḥ samālokya daṇḍinī śaravṛṣṭibhiḥmāyāṃ sasarja mahatīṃ dadṛśuḥ sarvaśaktyaḥsvayaṃ vāhānnihatyā'śu rathaṃ chittvā'pyanekadhācukruśurmāyayā tasya hāhetyuścaistu śaktyaḥalaṃ daityeṣu te devi līlayā bhītidānayānirmāyā'streṇa daiteyaṃ vimāyaṃ nāśaya drutamrathaneturvacaḥ śrutvā matvā yuktañca daṇḍinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāyuneva ca nīhāro naṣṭā māyā ca sarvataḥdṛṣṭvaiva taṃ daṇḍinī sākruddhā khaḍgena tacchiraḥevaṃ tasmin vinihate viṣaṅge bhīmavikramediśo vitimirā jātāḥ suprabhaśca divākaraḥviṣaṅgavadhavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥmuditāḥ śaktyaḥ sarvāstuṣṭuvurdaṇḍanāyikāmśokakātaratāṃ prāpa moheneṣanmahāsuraḥaho māṃ kiṃ vadāmīha śocantaṃ muktabhāvataḥevaṃ sā pūrayeccheṣamāśu nāstyatra saṃśayaḥvilambena mamā'trā'laṃ śreyo vighnairhi saṅkulamdiśatyeva parāmbā sā bhāvarūpā hi kāmadhukparamānandajananīṃ hitvā daivahato janaḥnīyate vyarthamaniśaṃ mṛtyorbhakṣyopasekatāmsamīkṣan kaśmalamamuṃ vimucya hatadehakamiti sañcintya daityendraḥ svāntarasyā'bhiguptayeni'hśeṣām tarasā yuktastayā yuddhāya daṃśitaḥśvetamuktā'tapatreṇa vījyamānaśca cāmaraiḥnadadvāditravipulairāsphoṭā'ravabṛṃhitaiḥrathavāhanasihānāṃ gartjitaiḥ pūrayan jagatathā'pa"yacchaktisenā bhaṇḍasenāmahārṇavamtatra mantramahārājñīṃ bhaṇḍaṃ yuddhāya saṅgatamdevi bhaṇḍaḥ svayaṃ prāpto yoddhumatyantasaṃyutaḥjaitrayātrā bhavatyāśca yuktā'tra yadi manyaseathā'bhavacchaktisenā sannaddhā nimiṣā'rddhataḥgajā'nīkasvāminī sā tatpaścāt sampadīśvarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadanu pracacālā'jā cakrarājamahārathaḥmuktācchatramahonnamraḥ padmaketudhvajocchrayaḥvāhayantī taṃ rathendraṃ mahātripurasundarīcakrarājaśatā'ṅgasya vāmadakṣiṇabhāgayoḥdaṇḍinīmantriṇībhyāṃ tau daṃśitābhyāmadhiṣṭhitautiraskṛtiścakrarājarathapṛṣṭhaṃ samāśritāutkhātavelladatyantakarālakaravālinīevaṃ śrīlalitādevī senayā saha niryayausenayorubhayoraśvarathebhapadacāriṇāmjanayadgāḍhatimiraṃ dārśanaiśamiva mahī vā sainyamarditātathā rajomahāsaṃghavegodrdhvagatihetutaḥityādi tarkamāpannā vaimānikagaṇāstadānadatsu yuddhavādyeṣu yukteṣvāsphoṭagarjanaiḥgadācakrabhindipālaparighāṅkuśayaṣṭibhiḥhatāḥ smaḥ sarvathā'smākaṃ śokaḥ putrādināśataḥvikramya yudhi jitvemāḥ śaktiḥ prāpsyām āśiṣamiti niścitya te daittyā yuyudhurbalavattaramhatvā jayaṃ paramakaṃ prāpsyāmo'dyaiva sarvathāevaṃ niyudhyamāneṣu śaktibhirditijeṣvathadecijjālīkṛtā'ṅgāstu śarajālairgatā'savaḥkeṣāñcit khaḍgaghātena śiraścaṭiti cotpatatpeṣitā mudgarāghātaiścakrarmadhye vidāritā ḥśaraiḥ śirāṃsi kṛttāni gagane yānti vegataḥvikīrṇāṅgaiścitā yuddhe bhūmirviruruce tadāasṛgvahā vavau tatra citrakārapramādataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: citrakāreṇa jhaṭiti pramṛṣṭa iva bhāṣatesamagralikhitānīva citrā.i dadṛśurnanunanāśā'sadya śaktīnāṃ senāgniṃ śalabho yathāśaktisenāṃ śastravarṣairarddayāmāsuruścakaiḥmantriṇī daṇḍinī cā'śvāruḍhā sampadadhīśvarītā yudhdhvā suciraṃ daityaiḥ sinādhīśairmahābalaiḥvakrākṣaṃ vāmanaṃ tālaṃ dīrghanasaṃ (ghoṇaṃ?) subāhukamsampatkarī tālajaṅghaṃ kuṭilākṣaṃ raṇoddhatamjambhanī krūravadanaṃ stambhinī sucikāmukhamkālakeyaṃ bhairavo'pi vyāghrāsyaṃ kālakarṣiṇīumlukaṃ karabhā'syañca mahākukṣiṃ śivāravamgṛghravāhaṃ kākamukhaṃ daṇḍinī nāśayadyudhisāhityaśayāmalā ceti nikumbhaṃ kumbhamastakamkaṭaṅkaṭaṃ karañjā'kṣaṃ muṇḍaṃ caṇḍaṃ kṛkā'nanamvakrakukṣiṃ vāmamukhaṃ kālakaṃ koṭaraṃ viṭamevaṃ niḥśeṣataḥ senāsenapeṣu hateṣvatharathaṃ prāpaya me śīghraṃ sārathe śaktivāhinīmśrutvā vākyaṃ daityapatervāhayan rathamāśu saḥdaityeśvara ! tvayā'jñptaḥ kiñcitpraṣṭuṃ samīhitamiti pṛṣṭena cājñapto prāha daityena sārathiḥviśukrādyā yayā yuddhe hatā līlāvilāsataḥhṛṣṭā'ntaram śokaleśā'spṛṣṭaṃ pravrajitaṃ yathābhaktirdevyāmatitarāṃ tanme brūhi yathātathamna śokaṃ nā'pi bhītiṃ vā lakṣaye tava leśataḥprāha bhaṇḍaḥ smayan kiñcitcchṛṇu daityetyupākraman
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etayā nihato yuddhe prāpsyāmyatyuttamam phalamemaṃ lokaṃ saśokaṃ vai sabhayaṃ duḥkhamātrakamtatrā'pyāsuraloko vai rājaso'tibhayaṅkaraḥahaṃ śrīpadmasaṃsthāno dūto māṇikyaśekharaḥtathā'pi kṛpayā devyā māṃ smṛtirno jahāti vaietayā nihatā yuddhe bhrātaro me sutā apimayā saha tvamapyāśu tallokaṃ prāpya bhrātṛbhiḥiti śrutvā bhaṇḍavaco viṣmito'bhūt sasārathiḥdṛṣṭvā śrīlalitāmagre namaścakre subhaktitaḥśrīdevībhaktirahasyaprakaṭanaṃ nāmaṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥmantriṇīñca samāsādya yuddhakauśalamulvaṇamdevyo vo yuddhacāturyavikramaistoṣito'smyahamsarvāstayā me yuddhakarmaṇitasyā padaṃ vinirjitya yuddhe vo'bhijayamyanuniśamya devyo matvā cā'jeyaṃ svīyaparākramaiḥdadurmārgaṃ niyuddhāya mahārājñyā'surasya viasamārabhadbhaṇḍadaityo yuddhamatyadbhūtaṃ tadāvaimānikairdevagaṇaiḥ siddhairṝṣigaṇaistathābhaṇḍa āsādya lalitāṃ puro dṛṣṭvā'tiharṣitaḥvivyādha pañcabhirbāṇaistadadbhutamivā'bhavattṛtīyaṃ kaṇṭhadeśe'bhūnmālikā phullapāṅkajīantyaṃ ratnamayaṃ mūrghni bhūṣaṇaṃ mukuṭe sthitamdevādayo'pi taddṛṣṭvā śaṅkitāstatra sarvathādeveśo'titarāṃ tatra viṣmayaṃ samapadyatacitraśastrāstranicayavyāptā'kāśamahodaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: santoṣayitumudyukto yuyodha paramā'stravitgūḍhā'padānavacanairadhikṣeptuṃ pracakramemṛṣā'cāraratā nityaṃ straiṇaṃ puruṣamāsritāna striyaṃ manye na pumāṃsamapi kvacitna tvaṃ satkulasambhūtā kulahīneva bhāsi meapi tvamabhimṛṣṭā'si sarvatheti vibhāsi meanarhāṃ darśane nūnaṃ paśyāmi purataḥ sthitāmmaddṛṣṭigocarībhūtā samprati tvaṃ kathañcanaāsāditā mayā sadyaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ na pradarśayaśakyaṃ hyadṛśyatāṃ yātuṃ tasmāttvaṃ susthirībhavadṛṣṭvā madīyavīryañca saṃsādhaya nijaṃ vratamśṛṇu daityeśvara vaco yaduktaṃ te tathaiva tatna hi me dṛṣṭiviṣayībhūya bhūyo bhavet kvacitityuktvā śaravarṣeṇa vavarṣa daityabhūpatimśastraprayogavijñānasaṃślāhanapuraḥsaramevaṃ niyudhya suciraṃ daityo'strāṇi sasarja hapārjanyamaindraṃ vāyavyaṃbrāhmaṃ kaumārameva capratyastrairnāśayāmāsa tuhinaṃ dinakṛdyathāsasarjā'tha bhaṇḍadaityo madhuṃ kaiṭabhameva cabalimarjunanāmānaṃ haihayaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tathāevamādīn viṣṇuśatrūn sarvān lokapraṇāśanānudyuktā lokanāśārthaṃ tamovṛttiparāyaṇāḥnārāyaṇā'vatārāṇāṃ sasarja daśak'm tadāatha bhūyo'ndhakaṃ mṛtyūṃ kāmaṃ tripurameva catān dṛṣṭvā śrīparā devī phālanetrādvisarjayat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atha daityamahāsenāmasaṅkhyātāṃ bhayāvahāmviṣaṅgaśca viśukraśca caturbāhumukhāḥ sutāḥatha te yuyudhuḥ śaktisenābhiratimaṣitāḥbhītāścā'tha kiṃ bhavedai iti devāśca śaktyaḥhataṃ hataṃ tatra daityo bhūyo bhūyaḥ sasarja hatadā śrīlalitādevīṃ tuṣṭuvurvidhimukhyakāḥkṛtāñjalirmadhurayā prārthayāmāsa vai girāpaśya śaktigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śuṣyadvaktraṃ samākulamhataṃ hataṃ śaktigaṇairbhūyaḥ sṛjati vaikṣaṇātkumāryā saptakṛtvaste bhūyo yudhyanti sampratihataḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭa eva bhaṇḍadaityena yudhyatiyudhyantyeva punaḥ sṛṣṭā netaḥ sādhyamidaṃ hi naḥrakṣa sarvaṃ lokamimaṃ nopekṣāṃ kartumarhasimā bhaiḥ paśya kṣaṇeṇaiva nāśayāmyasureśvaramtatrā'vāhya pāśupatamastraṃ lokabhayaṅkarambhasmīcakāra daityānāṃ senāṃ sāgarasammitāmtadā diśo'bhito jvālāmālālīḍhābhavan kṣaṇātcarācaraṃ jagajjālaṃ peturulkāḥ sahasraśaḥtāvaddṛṣṭvā vinaṣṭāṃ svāṃ senāṃ sāgarasannibhāmdhyeyamātrātmatāṃ yāvat prāpto bhaṇḍamahāsuraḥśaraṃ mumoca bhaṇḍāya sa śaro'tibhayaṅkaraḥcarācaraṃ jagajjālaṃ dahanniva nimeṣataḥbhaṇḍāsurañca sarathaṃ nagaraṃ tasya śūnyakambhasmaśeṣīkarottatra tadadbhutamivā'bhavatnagaram vā prahatasya daityārbhakamapi kvacit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhijaghnuḥ śaktigaṇā viāditrāṇi sahasraśaḥlāsyaṃ cakrurdevavārā urvaśyādyāḥ suharṣitāḥdadhyurmunigaṇā rūpaṃ praṇemuritare janāḥbalāhakāḥ saumyarūpā garjanto'tyantamantharammārutāḥ saugandhyayuto vavurānandanaspṛśaḥsanmanāṃsīva toyāni samāsan saridādiṣunirākulamasaṅkīrṇaṃ tadā bhaṇḍā'sure hatedevā maharṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve devīmupāyayuḥbhaṇḍāsuravadhavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥharṣanirbharitasvāntāstuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stavaḥsaṃśritebhyo'tiśīghramvyomamārgāḥbhavatu satatamasmanmānase nīrajaske viśadavikacavṛttau vāsite vāsanābhiḥbhūyo bhūyo'pi vividhaiḥ stavaistuṣṭuvurambikāmājagmurbhāratīmukhyaśaktiyuktā ghaṭodbhava !samīḍalalitāmīḍyāṃ prāhubarddhakarā'mbujāḥbrahmāṇḍānāṃ śataṃ pañca caiṣāṃ sa hyadhipo'bhavatlokā'dhipatyaṃ sarvatra daityaireva cakāra saḥna kvaciddaivayajño vā brahmayajño'pi śaṅkari !tadadya nihate daitye tvayā yudhi maheśvarisvasvā'dhikārakṛtyeṣu jātaṃ sarvaṃ nirākulamdevīṃ vidhimukhāṃścā'pi praṇamya racitā'ñjaliḥdevyāḥ śrīpuranirmāṇe tattathā racitaṃ mayāevaṃ tvaṣṭrā prārthito'jo devyai vṛttaṃ vyajijñapatśaktisenā devagaṇairyutā tatra yayau drutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāśrīpurarājasya pratibimbavivārpitamatha tatra nivasane devāḥ śrīlalitāmbikāmtatsammatiṃ samādāya buddhīśapramukhāstadāprakalpya sarbasambhārān śubhalagnamuhūrtakecakārā'gamadṛṣṭena mārgeṇottamakalpataḥgandhrvā devadūtāśca dikpālā yakṣaguhyakāḥvidyāghrāḥ siddhamunaya ṛṣayaḥ pitaro'surāḥsadāśiveśvarau cā'pi śrīkaṇṭho'nanta eva caparicerustatra devīṃ lalitā'mbāṃ samantataḥpṛthagabhūtaiḥ pūjayāmāsurādarātnadatsu śubhavādyeṣu mūrcchayatsu sumūrcchānāmgandharveṣu pranṛtyatsu devaveśyāsu sarvataḥstuvatsu vividheṣūccaiḥ prekṣatsu prāṇiṣūdyamaiḥatha mantraprapūtā'dbhirnavaratnavicitritaiḥabhyaṣiñcallokadhātā vaśiṣṭhapramudhairvṛtaḥvicitradivyavasanāṃ śrīcakrā'dhivirājitāmpūjayāmāsuramarā vividhaiḥ susamarhaṇaiḥstutvā vicitrastavanaiḥ praṇemurbhuvi daṇḍavatsiṃhāsane'bhiṣiktā sā mahāśrīpuravattadāevaṃ ghaṭodbhava mune ! meruśṛṅge mahonnatedevaśilpisvacāturyasarvasāravinirmitamprārthitā vidhimukhyaiḥ sā svīkṛtya karuṇāvaśātiti śrutvā hayagrīvāt kathāṃ paramapāvanīmhayagrīva dayāsindho ! merāvasmin tvayoditamna me hyaviditaṃ sthānaṃ brahmāṇḍāntarbhavet kvacit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: merumūrghni brahmaviṣṇuśivadhāmāni santi vaitat kathaṃ varṇitaṃ tatra śrīpuraṃ me samīrayaśṛṇu kumbhajaḥ ! vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamamye tu śrītripurāṃ śaktiṃ vidhinā samupāsatetatte māhātmyasaṃśrutyā bhaktirhṛdi samudgatāprāpte ratnākare yadvadbhavenno ratnavāñcitātasyā dīkṣāṃ samādāya copāsya vidhivatparāmetatte kumbhaja ! proktaṃ lalitāyā mahādbhutamkalau malīmasahṛdāṃ janānāṃ durdhiyāmidamvaidikaiḥ karmabhirbhūyo nirāśīrbhiḥ kṛtairvavetviṣṇau śive śaktiṣu ca sarvānte paripākataḥetadārādhanenaiva viditvā svā'tmarūpīmabhivyaktaparaiśvaryo na punarbhavamṛcchatiśravaṇaṃ śrīparāśaktimāhātmyavibhavonnateḥetat pāpapraśamanaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalāvahamityuktvā kumbhajamunipūjito'śvānano bhṛśamiti te kathitā rāma lalitāyāḥ kathā śubhāśrīlalitābhiṣekavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥjamadagnisutaḥ śrutvā harṣā'mṛtāniṣecitaḥnirantarasravaddharṣanetravāripariplutaḥbabhāṣe gadgadaśrutyā bhūyo viracitā'ñjaliḥparākathātīrthavāridhārānivahasecanaiḥnamaste śrīguro nātha duḥkhadhvāntadinādhipa !yo me mārga niradiśadandhasya bhramato yathāśūnyakūpe bheka iva na svārthamavidaṃ kvacit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mokṣalakṣmīmabhiprepsurabhavaṃ sarvathā nanutat pṛcchāmi bhavantaṃ yadvaktuṃj tanme samarhasinā'vaktvyaṃ mayi bhavecchiṣye kāruṇikasya tenopāsīttaṃ parāśaktiṃ sarvalokamaheśvarīmkuto va vedanirate na hi syāttasya darśanamityāpṛṣṭo jāmadagnyaṃ prāha dattagururmuniḥna hyatra kevalaṃ śāstraṃ prayojakamupeyatevāsanānāṃ śataṃ citte sañcitaṃ prāṇināṃ pṛthakyāvadyatsaṅgamāpnoti tāvat tat syānna cā'nyathāsañjātatripurābhaktiḥ patnyā dīkṣāṃ samādadena tāvanmokṣasaudhasya sopānā'rohaṇakṣamaḥna yogyatā tathā'trāpi vinā dīkṣāṃ bhṛgūdbahasvabuddhyā tu kṛtaṃ karma vidhinā ca samanvitamsevitāraṃ yathā hanti cā'pakvantu rasāyanamyaḥ samāsādayet sa hi devatādrohamāpnuyātajño drohakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ nāśayenmānavaḥ kathamyojayantyeva bhūpālā mahādaṇḍaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥvedavādaireva na hi bhavedatrā'dhikāritāpuruṣārtho vedavidhau sarvathā na hi vidyateaṇumātrā'tmabhūtānāṃ puruṣārthā'bhimānināmvaidikā hyacalammanyāḥ phalaṃ dhūmasamudbhavammiteṣu duḥkhabhūteṣu phaleṣu sukhabuddhayaḥpravartito guṇamayo vedo dhātrā jagatkṛtiḥmartukāmasya viṣavat kāmināṃ kāmanāmayaḥdhātraiva gopanāttasya guptabhāveṣu mohitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jīveṣu dayayā samyak cittā'rohopayogyayāato'tra tyaktakāmānāmadhikāro vidhīyateajñānāmnohato vā'pi vidyopāstiṃ tyajettu yaḥsannyāsinā tu tyaktavyaṃ sarvaṃ bandhātmanā sthitamna (hi) tyaktuṃ samucitaṃ brāhmaṇyamiva vai yateḥtāmisramandhatāmisraṃ kumbhīpākamavīcikamdaṇḍarājñyā samājñaptāḥ śaktyo'tivibhīṣaṇāḥupāstimārgasarujānaparādhaparān janānupāsanaparo martyaḥ kaivalyaṃ padamaśnutevaidikopāsakasyaiṣā sarvathā na hi vidyateanīśvaraṃ pauruṣaṃ syādataḥ paśuphalocitammocayatyāśu saṃsiddhyā śraddhābhaktisubṛṃhitamprāpyate'traiva śivatā prabuddhaiḥ pauruṣeṇa hinā'dhikāro vinā dīkṣāṃ karmaṇi jñānasādhanesadāśivena te samyak prabuddhāḥ śivarupiṇaḥtasmānna vedaśāstrādyaiḥ śuṣkaiḥ sadgatirāpyatena sādhanaṃ phalaṃ vā'pi pravṛttirvā.pi bhārgava !ārādhya śivaviṣṇavādīnapi yat prāpyate phalampūjanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ parāśakteḥ prapūjanamtasmāt pūjā tu śakteḥ syāt sarvatra vihitā janaiḥpūjayanti pṛthak devaṃ phalaṃ vindanti tattathāāśrayatvācchivamṛte śaktirnaiva tu vidyateprakāśaśaktihīno vai raviḥ kutra kadā bhāvetcitiśaktyā parityaktaṃ tṛṇaṃ vā'pi kathaṃ bhavetyadasti taścitiriti jānīhi bhṛgunandana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ buddhyā tu yat kiñcit tṛṇañca tripurātmakamtasmāttyajā'tra sandehametatsarvatra vai samamnirviśeṣantu tadrūpamakhaṇḍaikacidātmakamvedā viśeṣabahulā gūhayantyaviśeṣakamvedārthaḥparamo yastu tripuraiva hi sā bhavetvedārthasyaiva vyasanaṃ purāṇaṃ vyāsa ūcivāntasyā mūrttirataḥ sarvaṃ pravṛttaṃ saṃśrayātdayayā parameśānaḥ sarvānuddhartumicchayāāgamaḥ parameśasya vimarśa iti niścayaḥapāro hyāgamā'mbhodhiḥ sarvalokeṣu saṅgataḥṛṣibhistamāgamābdhiṃ mathitvā prājyayā dhiyādeśabhedavibhedena pṛthageva vibhāvitamśrautakarmamukhenaiva tāntrike hyadhikāritāveda eva hi tantraṃ syāttantraṃ vedaḥ prakīrtitamtathā hi vedabhāgeṣu tantrabhāgaḥ pradṛśyateevaṃvidho vedabhāgo yatastanmūrghni saṃsthitaḥtantreṣvapi vedabhāgā mantrabrāhmaṇabheditāḥevaṃ purāṇādiṣu ca tantrabhāgaḥ pradṛśyatesa purāṇaprabhāgaḥ syādevaṃ jānīhi bhārgava !āgamābdhistato vedāṃstantrāṇi ca vibhāvayaato'gastyastantradīkṣārahito vaidiko'pi sanatha śrutvā mahādevyā māhātmyaṃ sarbato'dhikampatnyā upāsya tripurāṃ tatra śrīnāthamaṇḍaloevaṃ tena samākrāntaṃ dṛṣṭañca sthānamuttamamnāmaikonā'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūyaḥ prāha prasannātmā praṇamya racitā'ñjaliḥabhavaṃ muktasandehaḥ kiñcit pṛcchāmi vai punaḥkurvannityakriyāṃ kena viśeṣeṇa hi karmaṇātanme samācakṣva guro kṛpayā mayi sevakeśṛṇu rāma mahāguhyaṃ tripurāprītikārakamnaivedaistu gaṇeśāno'laṅkārāddharireva caparāśaktirmaheśānī tatra sarvottamaṃ śṛṇutatra śrīcakrarājaṃ vā mūrtiṃ vā'pi sulakṣaṇāmpūjayet pañcakālaṃ vā catustrirdvyekakālakamnityaṃ vā dvitryekakālaṃ pañcakālañca parvasurathena vāhanairyānairutsavapratimāṃ bahiḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute loke sa vasecchrīpurā'ntareasamartho'nyavihite sthāpayeścakranāyakamna tasya punarāvṛttiḥ sāyujyaṃ vindate kramātyatra syāt sthāvaraṃ yantraṃ nivasaṃstatsamīpataḥupāsakastu jānīyāttatkṣetraṃ sarvato'dhikampūjayet sthāvaraṃ ckraṃ mūrtiṃ vā bhaktipūrvakamphalaṃ samāvahellakṣaguṇaṃ rāma ! na saṃśayaḥtatttsthāne bhāvayan vai mahāphalasamāptayesūryā'tmabhūtāstasyāṃ'sāḥ sarvalokaprasādakāḥtripurāyāḥ parāśakteḥ parivārākhyadevatāḥtasyāṃ'śabhūtāḥ sarvā vai tasmāt pūjyā yathāvidhītathaiva'vṛtiśaktīnāmaikyātmā tripurā matāyathākathañcidvā pūjyā sthāvare parameśvarītamātmaghnaṃ vijānīyāt sarvalokavininditam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇātāmbūladīpapraṇāmaparivartanaiḥ ?sahasrādyairnāmabhistu yaścakrādau prapūjayetmucyate nā'sti sandeha ityāha bhagavān śivaḥviśeṣaparvasu tathā śukravāre'pi vā'rabhettataḥ sampūjya vidhinā cā'vṛtyantaṃ maheśvarīmtatra puṣpopacārasya sthāne pūjāṃ samācaretsamāpayedyathāvatta pratyahañcaivamarcayetekajātīyakaiḥ puṣpaiḥ yatraiva pūjayet parāmante tu sarvatobhadre navayonisamāyutealaṅkṛtaṃ sūtravastrairmadhye taṇdulapuñjaketamaṣṭagandhatoyena pūrayet pañcaratnakamsataṇḍulaṃ phalaṃ pūrṇa pātrañcā'pi mukhe nyasetvinyasya tasyāmāvāhya pūjanantu samācaretdaśadikṣu ca dikpālān śṛṅkhalāsu caturṣu caraktār'dhabhavane pūrvāt prādakṣiṇyena pūjayetevaṃ sampūjya kalaśe pīṭhapūjanapūrvakamtattatpuṣ.pādikaṃ svarṇabhavaṃ vā rajatodbhavamtadardha pādamapi vā kṛtvā tannavasaṅkhyakammadhye ca tripurāṃ rātrau pūjayeścakranāyakamsvayaṃ vā pūjayedācāryeṇa vā kramavedināguruṃ suvāsinīñcāpi brāhmaṇādīnapi kramātkathābhirgāyanairnṛtyaiḥ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśipūjāṅgahomataḥ paścādagniṃ saṃsādhya śāstrataḥpūjāṃ samāpya coddhāsya kalaśaṃ vastrasaṃyutambrāhmaṇānāṃ ṣoḍaṣakaṃ suvāsinyaṣṭakaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00221 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhojayedbhakṣyabhojyādyairdakṣiṇādyaiśca toṣayetprasannā tripureśānī vāñchitārthapradā bhavetpitṝproddharate sarvanante mokṣaṃ samaśnutejapāpuṣ.paiḥ santatiṃ vai jātīpuṣ.pairgṛhādikamkiṃśukairoganihatiṃ kuṭajaiḥ śatrunāśanampūjayitvā vidhānena mahāphalamavāpnuyātlakṣavartipradīpairvā pūjayettripurā'mbikāmdaśakena śatenā'pi sahastreṇā'pi vā tathāekaikañca ghṛtā'pūrṇamarpayedekanāmabhiḥdaśā'vartanakairvāpi caikāvartanakena vāante svarṇena raupyeṇa navakaṃ varttiyugmakamnivedayettu kalaśe pāyasena hunettathāāvṛttīnāṃ lakṣakena sahasreṇa śatena vāmadhubhirvā phalarasairdadhibhirvā sugandhibhiḥante daśāṃ'śato banhau pāyasena hūnet kramātrudrābhiṣekato vā'pi mahāphalamudīritamadhanaistu śarīreṇa kartavyaṃ śubhasādhanamatha vā devatāsthāne paricaryāṃ samācare tuatimūḍhasya caitāvadeva kṛtyamudīritamdevatāśāstrapaṭhanāt pāṭhanācchreya āpnuyātsa dehānte vaidrume tu prākāre nivaseściramnivasedvāsantavapre ciramānanditā'ntaraḥabhirṣañcettathā śītatoyairapi suvāsitaiḥyastu rātrau dīpikābhiḥ prakāśayati mandiramevamatra yathā yo yaḥ sevāṃ kuryāttu mandire
